Tomorrow, my fundraising team has a meeting, and I’ll admit, I’m concerned.
**Over the past several weeks, our fundraising has really slowed down. For the first time this year, our campaign is falling behind and missing fundraising goals...**
We’ve been doing very well up until now. After I came just 546 votes short of winning in 2022, thousands of grassroots donors like you stepped up and chipped in to help me finish the job in 2024.
But I’ll be honest: **We cannot afford to fall behind and get out-spent again by the Super PACs. Not if we want to win this critical House seat.**
I am once again crisscrossing the district in my red pick-up truck, and everywhere we go, I meet Republican and Independent voters who are ready to elect someone to stop the angertainment circus.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81659241/463109919/-1503679382?refcode=BLU_EM_HFFC_2024-03-25_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDA1NzQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMGIwMjZjY2MtMDNlYi1lZTExLWFhZjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=NWtftB6gFRkWNCG2hKPyhK0l7W_sJXiiWhjjpC5hBiM=)

| Peter,

Hilary Franz knows that every American deserves access to high-quality, affordable health care. _No one should have to face the daunting choice between life-saving treatment and basic necessities like food and shelter._

As a former crisis clinic worker, Hilary has witnessed the struggles families face when they can't afford essential mental health care. Having been diagnosed nine years ago with a rare autoimmune disease, she also knows the high costs of prescription drugs and medical care costs. And she understands the challenges rural communities face, including long drives to understaffed medical facilities.

In Congress, Hilary will work tirelessly to keep rural hospitals open, invest in community health care services, stand up to Big Pharma, and fight for lower prescription drug costs. _**Above all, Hilary will champion a woman's right to make her own healthcare decisions.**_

As a former crisis clinic worker, Hilary has witnessed the struggles families face when they can't afford essential mental health care. Having been diagnosed nine years ago with a rare autoimmune disease, she also knows the high costs of prescription drugs and medical care costs. In Congress, Hilary will work tirelessly to keep rural hospitals open, invest in community health care services, stand up to Big Pharma, and fight for lower prescription drug costs. Peter — Josh Hawley could never understand the Missouri I know.

After nine months of posting weekly thoughts here on _**[Navigating Uncertainty](https://substack.com/redirect/68e9806e-2387-43ec-9f88-b342471df91c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_ , I've decided to pause and use this week to reflect on what I've learned while sharing some interesting stats. In general, the response has been better than expected and I remain grateful for the support and continued engagement of so many loyal readers. The newsletter currently has a subscriber count of around 23,000 here on[Substack](https://open.substack.com/users/81309935-substack?utm_source=mentions)and another 12,000 or so on [LinkedIn](https://substack.com/redirect/fb8b6ab9-14ba-4ced-afea-32b9e990d11b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Since my launch of the newsletter in July 2023, there have been more than 500,000 views of the articles I've written. In addition, the _**[Navigating Uncertainty](https://substack.com/redirect/1551337c-db7e-42ae-a69d-64a1a353ca74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_[ podcast](https://substack.com/redirect/1551337c-db7e-42ae-a69d-64a1a353ca74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and radio show reaches tens of thousands of listeners each week.
### _The Last Nine Months: Some Reflections_
One of the real benefits of forcing myself to write weekly is the routine helps me congeal my thinking around important issues. Because I pride myself on being a generalist, I spend hours each week scanning a wide variety of sources that help keep me informed. [But I don't want to be, as I note in my new book, "a jackass of many pursuits,"](https://substack.com/redirect/c0b20a59-0d13-4ba1-badb-a26998270329?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) I use my weekly pieces to dive deeper into one particular topic. This exercise helps balance my natural interest in breadth with some depth.
While I write to communicate my ideas, the act of writing has proven essential in the formation of those ideas. But the more I dug into the topic, I more I realized that higher rates would reduce the supply of homes for sale as consumers would retain low, locked-in mortgage rates. Yes, higher rates implied lower demand, but much higher rates, it turned out, also reduced supply. The impact on the housing market was ultimately unclear to me, so I decided to ask readers with a poll at the end of my article. 47% felt housing prices would fall, while 50% felt they'd stay flat or rise. _See article below._

As we work to make your voice heard and strive to change the tone in Washington, we need your help. Please consider [donating](https://vote4edgar.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d3a666e5996be881f1745f2f&id=9cd8ef6448&e=add163c1a3) if you can. # Campaign Highlights

We are less than 12 days away from the CD5 Assembly and our campaign team has been working non-stop to contact every single delegate in our district.
We are proud of the progress we’ve made so far, but our work isn’t over yet. We are confident, however, that we will outwork everyone else to secure our victory!
Here are some campaign highlights: We’ve mailed our letters to each of our 277 delegates asking for their vote at the CD5 Assembly!
* We’ve met one-on-one with several delegates and are scheduling more meetings in the next two weeks!
* We are the only campaign team that has produced concrete legislative proposals for solving our most pressing issues! This past week, we drafted a game-changing proposal to tackle climate change while boosting the middle class: stay tuned to learn more!
* We are in contact with national media outlets to talk about our policy proposals!
* We continue to make hundreds of calls to delegates every day!
* We are still receiving hundreds of dollars in donations every week from small donors!
* We are receiving major endorsements in the coming two weeks. Today we will be publishing an endorsement from co-founder and former executive director of the Arkansas Abortion Support Network!

name: Hillsdale College via American Briefing
subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zohtf7l7ki5ks3bqsj96b2glcu4uehglbbg5fm3g_rp22sh2s8i6ep34c5gmaob4cth2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zf3038bs1udmf26r3an5rdi3s9cbior6ou5a807g_rp22sh2s8i6ep34c5gmaob4cth2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zf400ge1o68kt99eaqneal5rhf2rmtl00sg0h5dg_rp22sh2s8i6ep34c5gmaob4cth2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat. A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is reaching and teaching millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions. These efforts include: Teaching bright and principled students --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, classical liberal arts education, including a required course on the Constitution Distributing Imprimis , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon Producing and promoting free online courses for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics Providing a classical K-12 curriculum with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our National Survey on the Department of Justice and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to reach and teach millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached National Survey on the Department of Justice , which you can access at this secure link: ** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Jonathan addressed the Mason District Republicans and the Mason District Republican Women in well-received presentations. Throughout the several hours spent at these venues, Jonathan heard repeatedly of concerns about the devolution of the nation under Biden and Kaine into a totalitarian state that is depriving Americans of individual liberty. He also heard complaints about the profligate "climate change" spending that is simultaneously destroying the fossil fuel backbone of the American economy and driving prices through the roof. Repeated expressions of support for those solutions and for the Emord campaign were conveyed by the great majority of members of both groups.

Jonathan joined the American Hindu Coalition's members for an interview regarding his positions on issues of importance to the Hindu community. Those issues dovetail with those of great concern throughout Northern Virginia among most residents, including the rise in crime due to the anti-incarceration and early release agendas of Soros-backed Commonwealth's Attorneys; the Fairfax County Public School system's reliance on race-based advancement instead of meritocracy, noted in particular at Thomas Jefferson High School for Science and Technology; the expansion of sex trafficking throughout the schools in Northern Virginia and the purposeful failure of Soros-backed Fairfax County Commonwealth's Attorney Steve Descano to prosecute a single sex trafficking case during his tenure; and the open border crisis devaluing citizenship by eliminating protection for the franchise and for life, liberty and property against the illegal invasion.

### Mar 12 Door-to-door Petition Collections

Jonathan joined members of Team Emord in door-to-door visits throughout McLean, Falls Church, Arlington, and Alexandria, Virginia. The team met with and heard from voters throughout the Northern Virginia region. Public dissatisfaction with Biden and Kaine was quite evident from these interactions. From the dozens of interactions, we came away with the distinct impression that in Northern Virginia a combination of local government overreach, inflation due to excess federal government spending, regulatory compliance costs, and the woke agenda in the public schools are top issues. Medium and small sized businesses, particularly independent shops in the retail sector, are being crushed by inflated costs of source goods and materials, higher rent, and regulatory compliance costs. Many employees and business owners informed us that they can barely survive in the current economy because of high grocery and gas costs. Many complained of having to dip deeply into savings to pay mortgages and to cover the costs of food and gas, utility bills, and taxes. A dramatic downsizing of the government is critically needed along with elimination of regulations that are robbing us of jobs, economic opportunities for advancement, and sustainable economic growth.

body:
This is how we hold Biden accountable.

| | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zf88ekjjfco1kus5rov6og9vguad8ji0h8vl0lu0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34c5gmeoj3cjh2bs)
---
Friend, I’m writing to you today with a big update on my investigation, and I ask you to take the time to read this email in its entirety. I spent a lot of time writing it and did my best to make every word count. If you don’t read it, nobody will. **First, there is no question in my mind that Joe Biden and his family are guilty of corruption.** I’ve presented mountains of evidence confirming Joe Biden’s involvement in his family’s influence peddling scheme, and I just had a group of the Biden family’s business confidants publicly testify about the first family’s criminal activity. _**At any other time in history, that would have been the final nail in the coffin of the Biden Crime Family’s reign of corruption.**_
| [**STAND WITH COMER**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z5neptl3e1s4fq5oqg9m2docsei71eniqjgqu268_rp22sh2s8i6ep34c5gmeoj3cjh2bs)
---
But we are not in a normal time in history, we are in a defining moment where our country will either return to the rule of law being applied equally to everyone, or we will continue down this Orwellian path and the destruction of the American ideal. As it stands right now, the deranged Democrats are refusing to take up the Impeachment Trial of Alejandro Mayorkas and threatening to dismiss it within minutes when it finally is brought up. **Even “centrist” Democrats called the Mayorkas Impeachment Trial “ridiculous” just days after a criminal illegal brutally murdered Laken Riley in cold blood.** _What do you think they would do if we Impeached Biden?_ It’s clear that Democrats will choose their party over their country and the truth at every turn. They should be ashamed of themselves. **That’s why I am preparing criminal referrals as the culmination of my investigation.** **When President Trump returns to the White House, it’s critical the new leadership at the DOJ have everything they need to prosecute the Biden Crime Family and deliver swift justice.**
| [**STAND WITH COMER**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zqf4tns20ge6qspmq7eunjsbno0gvb1tcjjfbhk0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34c5gmeoj3cjh2bs)
---
This is the best way to hold the Biden’s accountable for their crimes, as it’s now clear the Democrats will do anything to hold onto power. I am dead serious when I tell you that the Democrats in D.C. only care about one thing. They don’t care about the Constitution, the Rule of Law, or even their sacred oaths of office. They only care about POWER. And we must make sure that no matter what hijinks they try to pull before the election that they are removed from power in every branch of government. [**That’s why I am in dire need of your support.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zmu133soj2fmd1l34aetofpt7kv1hs713eu7jk6g_rp22sh2s8i6ep34c5gmeoj3cjh2bs) I’m on the frontlines here in D.C. fighting to uphold the constitution and rid our government of corruption, but as the old adage goes, no good deed goes unpunished. It’s a damn shame that me and my family are being put through this just because I have the courage to speak truth to power. There was a time not long ago when every American knew that having courage in the face of power was virtuous, and I still do. [**If you do too, then I’d be honored to have your support as I defend myself and my good name from the disgusting attacks I continue to face.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zpiff7tkjmg2s7du5koj08467fjh87v9srtlpku0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34c5gmeoj3cjh2bs) I’d love nothing more than to go back to my farm in Kentucky and raise my family in peace, but this moment calls for men and women of courage and conviction to fight for our country. I believe with every fiber of my being that America is worth saving and I’m ready to fight with everything I have to save her. [**Friend, I’m calling on you to fight with me.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z1bs0iefaj7nvo92go2kt4079cm62vebldhkqb38_rp22sh2s8i6ep34c5gmeoj3cjh2bs)
_With Courage,_
James Comer Chairman, House Oversight Committee

But wait, that's not even the half of it. It gets worse:

** Problem #2: ** House Democrats have forty million bucks stashed away to attack pro-Trump Conservatives like us.

** Problem #3: ** Joe Biden just bragged about raising a million bucks in a SINGLE DAY attacking President Trump.

_**[I only ask everyone reading this to pitch for a few bucks or whatever you can afford.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zu9uhjl0bau4dtko8p35oojj9ioekukk8s1iu6rg_rp22sh2s8i6ep34c5gmeoj1clh2bs "I only ask everyone reading this to pitch for a few bucks or whatever you can afford.")**_

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: tomorrow’s the day!
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

Any time the Supreme Court prepares to make a pivotal decision on abortion, _Students for Life Action’s_ _**SCOTUS Squad**_ is always the first on the scene!

And **TOMORROW, March 26th,** we’ll once again be flooding the steps of the Supreme Court with the future of deadly Chemical Abortion Pills up in the air with two cases – _FDA v. Alliance for Hypocritic Medicine_ and _Danco Laboratories v. Alliance for Hippocratic Medicine._

This is always a nightmare for the Abortion Lobby because if there’s one thing that shatters their narrative . . .

**It’s a large gathering of pro-life young people – _especially when many of them are smiling young women!_**

The great news is, my staff just informed me that the turnout tomorrow is going to be much larger than we expected!

So large, in fact, that I’m worried the coffee and donuts we provide for them are going to run out before many of them even get there.

**[So, with our SCOTUS Squad heading to Capitol Hill TOMORROW, could you please help me supply our students with some donuts and coffee by chipping in just $7](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-skukkit-duchtdja-y/)?**

Pro-Life Friend, any time the U.S. Supreme Court takes up an abortion-related case, it’s a news and PR madhouse in Washington, D.C.

The pro-abortion media always does whatever they can to use images to spread the _**LIES**_ that young people can’t get enough of abortion-on-demand and that pro-lifers are somehow “anti-women.”

That’s why when the media shows up tomorrow, they’ll be punching the air when they see our _**SCOTUS Squad**_ – _many of them young women_ – on the Supreme Court’s steps!

They’ll be forced to cover the sheer size and power of the Pro-Life Movement and grapple with the fact that we’re growing.

Of course, our movement wouldn’t be growing if it wasn’t for all of our dedicated student activists who put themselves on the line every day fighting against the Abortion Lobby.

So, will please help me reward all our activists in the best way one can make a young person happy???

**_With food!_**

**[A gift of just $7 to _Students for Life Action_ will help me make sure we have enough donuts and coffee for our SCOTUS Squad tomorrow](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-skukkit-duchtdja-j/)!**

**[Of course, a generous gift of $10, $25, $50, $100, or more would be extremely helpful and much appreciated](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-skukkit-duchtdja-i/)!**

Please keep the hearing tomorrow in your prayers. Pray that our Justices listen to the facts and not the spin by the abortion industry. Their decision on these cases this June could save the lives of mothers and babies.

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

Dear Pro-Life American,

A disheartening reality is unfolding before us.

America, a nation built on freedom and the right to life, is threatened by disturbing policies that endanger thousands of unborn babies. The Biden Administration's policies are catalyzing the most pro-abortion administration we've ever seen.

Biden supports heart-wrenching late-term abortions, encourages cover-up of infanticide, endorses unrestricted access to abortion drugs, and is determined to establish abortion-on-demand in our Constitution.

In essence, his administration serves death rather than life, leaving thousands of unborn babies and vulnerable women at risk.

We at SBA Pro-Life America envision a world where every life is cherished. Where pain, despair, and death are replaced by compassion, support, and life. But this vision requires your unwavering support right now.

It's not just about standing against policies; it's about standing for lives - your life, my life, our children's lives, and those precious babies who are yet to be born.

We believe in the power of collective action. Join us as we champion the cause for life, rise above partisan politics, and fight against the deadly agenda of Big Abortion. You, as an individual, hold a powerful weapon - your voice. Use it in defense of those who cannot defend themselves before it's too late.

Time is ticking and we need you to take action TODAY!

Tell Joe Biden NO! No to unrestricted access to abortion drugs. No to painful late-term abortions. No to abortion-on-demand.

Help us serve women, save babies, and protect America by turning down the most pro-abortion administration in history! Together, we can leave a legacy of life and love for future generations.

[Click here to join SBA Pro-Life America in signing this crucial petition.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zqcmcsla5m6746n552j3i38oeha2tpb9gpgfajbg_rp22sh2s8i6ep34c5im0o72chh2bs)

For Life,

Dear Pro-Life American,

A disheartening reality is unfolding before us.

America, a nation built on freedom and the right to life, is threatened by disturbing policies that endanger thousands of unborn babies. The Biden Administration's policies are catalyzing the most pro-abortion administration we've ever seen.

Biden supports heart-wrenching late-term abortions, encourages cover-up of infanticide, endorses unrestricted access to abortion drugs, and is determined to establish abortion-on-demand in our Constitution.

In essence, his administration serves death rather than life, leaving thousands of unborn babies and vulnerable women at risk.

We at SBA Pro-Life America envision a world where every life is cherished. Where pain, despair, and death are replaced by compassion, support, and life. But this vision requires your unwavering support right now.

It's not just about standing against policies; it's about standing for lives - your life, my life, our children's lives, and those precious babies who are yet to be born.

We believe in the power of collective action. Join us as we champion the cause for life, rise above partisan politics, and fight against the deadly agenda of Big Abortion. You, as an individual, hold a powerful weapon - your voice. Use it in defense of those who cannot defend themselves before it's too late.

Time is ticking and we need you to take action TODAY!

Tell Joe Biden NO! No to unrestricted access to abortion drugs. No to painful late-term abortions. No to abortion-on-demand.

Help us serve women, save babies, and protect America by turning down the most pro-abortion administration in history! Together, we can leave a legacy of life and love for future generations.

I spent a lot of time writing it and did my best to make every word count. If you don’t read it, nobody will. **First, there is no question in my mind that Joe Biden and his family are guilty of corruption.** I’ve presented mountains of evidence confirming Joe Biden’s involvement in his family’s influence peddling scheme, and I just had a group of the Biden family’s business confidants publicly testify about the first family’s criminal activity. _**At any other time in history, that would have been the final nail in the coffin of the Biden Crime Family’s reign of corruption.**_
| [ **STAND WITH COMER** ](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/KbEAWNVtsLoyDlG0n5do2Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRn5SfWP0R1aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9jb21lci1mb3ItY29uZ3Jlc3MvamNfZG9uX3BvcGFfZXJfYmktY3JpbXJlZl9yc18yMDI0MDMyNT91dG1fdGM9Uk9OLTIwMjQwMzI2JnJlY3VycmluZz10cnVlVwNzcGNCCmX8k4sCZjZbvOBSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)
---
But we are not in a normal time in history, we are in a defining moment where our country will either return to the rule of law being applied equally to everyone, or we will continue down this Orwellian path and the destruction of the American ideal. As it stands right now, the deranged Democrats are refusing to take up the Impeachment Trial of Alejandro Mayorkas and threatening to dismiss it within minutes when it finally is brought up. **Even “centrist” Democrats called the Mayorkas Impeachment Trial “ridiculous” just days after a criminal illegal brutally murdered Laken Riley in cold blood.** _What do you think they would do if we Impeached Biden?_ It’s clear that Democrats will choose their party over their country and the truth at every turn. They should be ashamed of themselves. **That’s why I am preparing criminal referrals as the culmination of my investigation.** **When President Trump returns to the White House, it’s critical the new leadership at the DOJ have everything they need to prosecute the Biden Crime Family and deliver swift justice.**
| [ **STAND WITH COMER** ](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/KbEAWNVtsLoyDlG0n5do2Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRn5SfWP0R1aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9jb21lci1mb3ItY29uZ3Jlc3MvamNfZG9uX3BvcGFfZXJfYmktY3JpbXJlZl9yc18yMDI0MDMyNT91dG1fdGM9Uk9OLTIwMjQwMzI2JnJlY3VycmluZz10cnVlVwNzcGNCCmX8k4sCZjZbvOBSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)
---
This is the best way to hold the Biden’s accountable for their crimes, as it’s now clear the Democrats will do anything to hold onto power. I am dead serious when I tell you that the Democrats in D.C. only care about one thing. They don’t care about the Constitution, the Rule of Law, or even their sacred oaths of office. They only care about POWER. And we must make sure that no matter what hijinks they try to pull before the election that they are removed from power in every branch of government. [**That’s why I am in dire need of your support.**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/KbEAWNVtsLoyDlG0n5do2Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRn5SfWP0R1aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9jb21lci1mb3ItY29uZ3Jlc3MvamNfZG9uX3BvcGFfZXJfYmktY3JpbXJlZl9yc18yMDI0MDMyNT91dG1fdGM9Uk9OLTIwMjQwMzI2JnJlY3VycmluZz10cnVlVwNzcGNCCmX8k4sCZjZbvOBSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) I’m on the frontlines here in D.C. fighting to uphold the constitution and rid our government of corruption, but as the old adage goes, no good deed goes unpunished. It’s a damn shame that me and my family are being put through this just because I have the courage to speak truth to power. There was a time not long ago when every American knew that having courage in the face of power was virtuous, and I still do. [**If you do too, then I’d be honored to have your support as I defend myself and my good name from the disgusting attacks I continue to face.**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/KbEAWNVtsLoyDlG0n5do2Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRn5SfWP0R1aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9jb21lci1mb3ItY29uZ3Jlc3MvamNfZG9uX3BvcGFfZXJfYmktY3JpbXJlZl9yc18yMDI0MDMyNT91dG1fdGM9Uk9OLTIwMjQwMzI2JnJlY3VycmluZz10cnVlVwNzcGNCCmX8k4sCZjZbvOBSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) I’d love nothing more than to go back to my farm in Kentucky and raise my family in peace, but this moment calls for men and women of courage and conviction to fight for our country. I believe with every fiber of my being that America is worth saving and I’m ready to fight with everything I have to save her. body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=12bc3cc9823a47dd8b4d93a631b4b617&_e=jFc3E_vNw7LkPixaPOzWZNAXl5s1B7Jl6G6MEL3p8POIprsvmjj1hYYUA7sXnZKK566486lheRGgT8QKaAagLg_ViHZtdohyJjlkfIJjZ38GGopO9FRai2715XcYAXbysp0W7i9g3-pc7yzNBkFTg2QFXtep5JaxyIFJYqeHtDjZZbPvPDEpqpNk17srkhlsoQ6lqcpQHXyLWrHQg9lF0N5rsMOFy2KawcTA3vhBLbcAP_dL2NBgIdxwcgPRl7lxVT9h_R4Dg1QAHns-4TGd3M6lC1uY6m6pUFZcOEGvkV7GHS3Q5JMiYUYPjSH-zHRJqIu7NlnO2_2MCbdiEdRzW2aUIPLNpC0DUZHeJhvgDBur2gKtD1t6vKTQCGT0xj5Un19g9atKFlN6niDh8k_D2g%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=12bc3cc9823a47dd8b4d93a631b4b617&_e=jFc3E_vNw7LkPixaPOzWZNAXl5s1B7Jl6G6MEL3p8POIprsvmjj1hYYUA7sXnZKK566486lheRGgT8QKaAagLg_ViHZtdohyJjlkfIJjZ38GGopO9FRai2715XcYAXbysp0W7i9g3-pc7yzNBkFTg2QFXtep5JaxyIFJYqeHtDjZZbPvPDEpqpNk17srkhlsoQ6lqcpQHXyLWrHQg9lF0N5rsMOFy2KawcTA3vhBLbcAP_dL2NBgIdxwcgPRl7lxbo9uI_6_afrNOiJuJBSrsC0MWdtTsVpc-tO8Lgd83pgYxmDyuekEfbH-vIYUQtxqKdovzWtAZOk_o3KQJy7x-cn2n-GQAJ0O5ijYvwBp710E82-i9snxG44C1ozTWgGRhASOKYchTBbtfIFXGMRRcw%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=12bc3cc9823a47dd8b4d93a631b4b617&_e=jFc3E_vNw7LkPixaPOzWZNAXl5s1B7Jl6G6MEL3p8POIprsvmjj1hYYUA7sXnZKK566486lheRGgT8QKaAagLg_ViHZtdohyJjlkfIJjZ38GGopO9FRai2715XcYAXbysp0W7i9g3-pc7yzNBkFTg2QFXtep5JaxyIFJYqeHtDjZZbPvPDEpqpNk17srkhlsoQ6lqcpQHXyLWrHQg9lF0N5rsMOFy2KawcTA3vhBLbcAP_dL2NBgIdxwcgPRl7lxxnRGJFmUrcqJ1pYTNnxTkwclYWoLsBBJQP2WmJd7Bs1xwwGKJPDKmdNv44O4LRsqekVd9V3RcJ1kBH6T9KMyDNP-XJqZ0wGnbmALVnMws3okr2d3zRm7kXH4X0cA5ujMtSkiABmP4vn7NJjwu_ItLA%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. ** Problem #1: ** We have TWO imminent Special Elections and Democrats committed more than five million dollars to install more Liberals.

## Trump Wins Bond Victory in Appeals Court
A New York appeals court Monday agreed to [reduce former President Donald Trump's bond](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2OszAQAJ8GOkdmvTGmcPE16fK1VyL_rMOeDFjGIcrbn3L1laNpRvN1n--OM2-P_24l29I-u9D4pFkJ0AJwxj7aRASkerLDOAyopQTVLzZ6OQZ3xSTRg78GozBG8uQhTYM3umcLElAq0HK6asSL1y4FTEgTTGAm06GkyG2vl--dt7ZQyu_9pHoJ-9pnu7RWjk796-DWwc2VjV7HR32gNg6ZOri1-lyLCHxyFqm6ZxTBHSROqpFDE4U2l9tbuFLIZWEQx4AmSlRaGjWqEST6QaEcUJkIfbWxvDhnPvTYoXysjvNvTvtzzk8AAAD__zMrZEw) to $175 million and give him ten more days to raise it, saving Trump from immediate seizure of any of his assets. Trump had been facing the need to raise more than $454 million to satisfy the bond requirement in his civil fraud case. However, the appeals court delayed that deadline and halted other parts of the ruling that would have kept Trump family members from holding corporate office in New York. Trump welcomed the news as a victory and said he [would post the $175 million bond ](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGOpDAQBNCvMVkj024MBASXkM2lFyIPtMFzBiPbDJr9-hUbb1yq0lP9e4wP47zbl79m4z7bMJopuzePClAD0kjF3FtmZFVwXzVVRVpKVMXaz62u1NOo2dq5pfo5WWrbRla1sWbSsilcjxJJKtSyqzVR-dTGTmSJO-yw7VpBkmeXQyxfwe15Zes_4c2xnMJW-H7N-UhC_RE4CByu6yojn5ljunOBg-fFeIFDjud2wGoSrOGMCaZ7A6gm2Jz3LuzwOudl4z1DiBBd-g9HDAfH_IHE7uuMDLcUpAKsBQ5F7OfjurtJN4Lkshnnf1D514u-AwAA__8Vw2in)by the deadline. Posting the bond will halt actions against his assets until a full appeal is heard, which could take months.
## Boeing CEO to Step Down in Shakeup
Boeing CEO Dave Calhoun will step down at year's end, as part of [a broad management shakeup](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvwyAQRn8N3rDwQUw8MHTxlq4drTMc8VVgIkzj9t9X6dztkz7p6el93JYbcuL9_o6ZXItlQd_4SYuWMEowi-mCi0RAuiM32GEwo1Kgu80h2mCjvg42YBjIm9FbFRCjD5cJiTp2oMAoDaOaLqMx_Tpi9CYammCC63QVRlHgVmr_WXhvG8X0U55Ue19yl9zW2uMQ-k3ALGA-z7P3--pfp4D5hRYwK_3aFwHzWoj3u_RU5FqwBuk35Cp9yZmqZ0xyIwyyfDVptZUZv6WvfPDRby2nrrrwODklPkYrjLpn5PTn0f6t8hsAAP__XqhjPw) at the troubled aircraft manufacturer. Also leaving will be board chairman Larry Kellner, who won't run for reelection to the job this year, and Stan Deal, CEO of the commercial airplane unit, effective immediately. Boeing has [been under pressure](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL8GNkdwXM9hYOiSLV07WnAcMRUxkUMT9e-rdO749IYnvc_zco611e3yEa8SRulL5FEfsrgJaAJcUOdQRECclmBna5GMAafX4NBC5uSzWECATEnSHLkYmuEIRnQNYACNAzL-jRAPiWJhLCgePBz9UaGRXEffD1-9bmOV0n76Q_YD96tuYR3jdlfuXcFJwSneNnneX-oF-6jcRMEpdanbZWLpE8e29u9tMjGVYpmZgKCUZFzxM1Mk61O2wnoP-fasrdU7zQrN5Rpr-2uOfw_8BgAA__9naFuo) since a door blew out of a 737 Max in January. Since then, it's faced federal investigation, aircraft delivery problems, and criticism from its client airlines.
## Feds Raid Sean "Diddy" Combs' Mansions
Homeland Security officials [raided](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFy6yAQRb9G6vCgBSMoKF7jzq9NqYFl19oESR6JseO_zzh1yntPc-Z8XKdrkirr7X9aKDbepoRNHjQZBU6BnWxfIhMBmZ7iMA6DdVqD6ecYXPCQszWYzmMCZsxnq21CDQUN-14iaLDagNPh7Kw9ZZcYLVsKEMAH31lNRdq2nz43WdtMXF_bg_YTbktf49za_ejMvw4uHVzSfaXn8UbvsTfBSh1cmMqhDko7zqpIKS-F25Lf17dqe2IW_JL1prz3hgrgaLRnw1gyYGFtOJOBUIZ-j-X-lFrlcGNn9W1JUn9F2p9ZfgIAAP__xGNjkg) rap mogul Sean "Diddy" Combs' properties in Miami and Los Angeles yesterday. Combs has been the subject of [multiple sexual assault lawsuits](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL8Gb0T4IGAPDF28pWtH6-COmAqbyCap_PdVOnd9b3l6X7f5hrnk7f6JK_uW6oyx5RfPWoKVYGbTkU_MwLpj37u-N1Yp0N3iA9HVKiSnjLNDGhyii2xSQGRNSnfZgwKjNFg1Xq0xl2AxRZMMjzDCMA7CKKbc6n75rnlrC6dy1hfvl1jXrviltcch9IeAScCEIbq3EDAdjJukTHTKWNdwyMczJUn4BktdueBG8uD43HM75Y6ZZECSoZ4y5bIeAqbeXO1oBytg6nZPj59cSj6sE0bdV8zlL6H9O-Q3AAD__8KEYeE) over the last few months, and the raids on his homes were part of a federal investigation into sex trafficking. Several people were taken in handcuffs from Combs' Los Angeles home ([see video](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FugzAQQL_G3oyOs2PC4KELW7p2RId9Dq4MjsAN5e-rZs749Ian93Ubb5RyWu-ftLCrsYzka3ryqBVahWY0MrjIjKwlu7ZrW2MBUMvZIbA1XWSaogfUAIE6grZn7ekSA8nkENCARgv9xRrTTJaiN9Fwjz1e-6swwCHVsjXfJa115pjP8uSt8WWR2c21PnahPwQOAofjOJpYfjP9W4HDyscucMik5rKw2igFDmo6X5hpDWpn_7OlesrNhceRck677YSB-0Ipvxr17fFfAAAA__-SHFi7)), and his two sons were temporarily detained during the search. As heavily armed federal officials served search warrants and entered his properties, [Combs was filmed](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FqwzAQgOGnkbaE0-kkWYOGLt7SqVDoYhT5lKjIcbCvCX37Qrt2_uGH7_00nXLr7XZ5zQsnqeuUi7QHT_aA_oA0kZ5TZUa2mpMJxpAHQKuvictcB1fQlWIz-xrKEM7oInnHdQbQLSEggUUP0Xmi49nnWqgSR4w4xEER8Nxk3Y6fa7vJlWv_Xh-8Hcu66J6uIvdd2ReFo8JRnk3krykc304fCsddsnztCkcTApKNkQBcCIYGY_SW5vuz9d52HxTBZcmt_57lX-dPAAAA__9AeVEb) pacing around at a Miami airport. body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8bd8f053e4fc4d239b5d2ab722cf1d4c&_e=XrWFCsBQof-mi-HvXb0-CkRtcfYRPPj9LW6rlGRHxCLxp-nnx7MjwxTOKYvXt11cMqlcsbAs-eaYwArMOPP4ZOAqtSDrGtWUis82R8Ye5c2Q7AtDLQhvY9phkgIbJod9-qhJQyEUbVidnX5Rn41N0e_uRk66pMCVLb28xXFHKxuADlh1Ue2QZCsXRrS1ti_pt9dao209SnDz9J3IXux66fpy_MqtR9iVho9X5t4g7j42NnaSANVAhSEfvnobekykqsURzJH_evGlEKezMoMgWUXHMpZvVpEyXYQa9jFtqUGHU0V4ApT20gh_ssBeycu-7B9weVlE4tQs4qi2p4lymH4WafcyoyjPMrb5e642u_5FK28yujky4D_qNKv6BDnEqG5rNkXnI3W103XwIBgoig%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8bd8f053e4fc4d239b5d2ab722cf1d4c&_e=XrWFCsBQof-mi-HvXb0-CkRtcfYRPPj9LW6rlGRHxCLxp-nnx7MjwxTOKYvXt11cMqlcsbAs-eaYwArMOPP4ZOAqtSDrGtWUis82R8Ye5c2Q7AtDLQhvY9phkgIbJod9-qhJQyEUbVidnX5Rn41N0e_uRk66pMCVLb28xXFHKxuADlh1Ue2QZCsXRrS1ti_pt9dao209SnDz9J3IXux66fpy_MqtR9iVho9X5t4g7j42NnaSANVAhSEfvnobekykaf2mHo7YHWqdQPlerxkavf1FLJgjzAQcc-JdNHSH4cy4UQs9OAM30MJe8CYJTviy_R11WnARSHQZl0S6ScEUjWltsXl8ZFP9DZtXMSZ-K47fN1cd-qCeaiiEkhs_D7MjL0DzkhgMxdVY05LhORKSFg%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8bd8f053e4fc4d239b5d2ab722cf1d4c&_e=XrWFCsBQof-mi-HvXb0-CkRtcfYRPPj9LW6rlGRHxCLxp-nnx7MjwxTOKYvXt11cMqlcsbAs-eaYwArMOPP4ZOAqtSDrGtWUis82R8Ye5c2Q7AtDLQhvY9phkgIbJod9-qhJQyEUbVidnX5Rn41N0e_uRk66pMCVLb28xXFHKxuADlh1Ue2QZCsXRrS1ti_pt9dao209SnDz9J3IXux66fpy_MqtR9iVho9X5t4g7j42NnaSANVAhSEfvnobekykdd5vU8i4xsJ8ta_RNnhVZQgB-2rCzWW4hCSHugQD9cYkaGbvVNedenVyDvLVWFa3bTgaO0mdO8Q6zjzdM6gQsiZ9ox_xAon1sINCzmlpJ9JTHBBNKNC6CApcosAcPrnjkHIAm-aDDl5Mvfhf0lVQ_g%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

name: Bryan
subject: Campaign Update
body:
Here's what's going on: | | | | |
---
There’s been a lot happening in Congress and back home in Wisconsin over the last few weeks. I know that we’re all very busy and it’s difficult to keep up with the news, so let me give you a brief update about what’s been happening lately.

**Joe Biden’s Visit to Wisconsin**
Joe Biden recently visited Milwaukee. He came to tout his record on the economy, but we know that Biden’s economy simply isn’t working for us right now.
The numbers don’t lie. Since Joe Biden took office:
\- Inflation is up 17%\- The typical household spends more than $11,400annually\- Mortgage payments on median priced homes have doubled
Joe Biden’s policies are continuing to hurt us in Wisconsin. The contrast between Democrats and Republicans view on the economy will be clear this November.
[Click Here to Hear My Response to President Biden’s Visit](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=18578599ea&e=e907534017)
**Private Money Influencing Wisconsin Elections**
I’ve spent the last year working on developing policy that boosts voter confidence by implementing commonsense election integrity reforms. That’s why I introduced the Americans’ Confidence in Elections Act.
[Click Here to Learn More About My Bill](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=5d6c28f9c0&e=e907534017)
One of the key election integrity provisions in my bill includes banning private funding, commonly known as Zuckerbucks, from election administration. Private election funding distorts Americans’ confidence in our elections, and we’ve seen that first-hand in Wisconsin.
This week we saw this problem re-emerge in Milwaukee [when it was reported](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=8bb06c4125&e=e907534017) the Milwaukee Election Commission was seeking $800,000 in private money ahead of the 2024 election. In the past, this private money has financed get-out-the-vote efforts in Democrat-leaning cities and counties. I believe this practice should be stopped.
The good news is that on April 2nd we’ll have a chance to ban private money from Wisconsin elections by voting YES on Constitutional Amendment questions 1 and 2. This will be our best opportunity to keep dark money out of our elections.

**An Update on Our Race**
House Republicans currently hold a two-seat majority. It’s one of the smallest majorities in American history. National Democrats aren’t wasting any time trying to take back control, and the First District of Wisconsin is one of their top targets.
As you might’ve seen, they’re running misleading ads against me in the Milwaukee media market. Their most recent ad buy brings their total to $1.7 million spent against me on Milwaukee TV ads in the last 6 months.
In 2023, more money was spent attacking me than any Republican in Congress.
Their most recent attack against me was labeled MOSTLY FALSE by PolitiFact.
I’m going to keep working hard to bring our conservative message to every corner of our district, but we’ll need an army of volunteers. If you want to help us out, click the link below:
[Join Our Team!](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=17b62be7f7&e=e907534017)

On Wisconsin,
Bryan Steil

| | | [View email in browser](https://mailchi.mp/b65b12e791c9/campaign-update?e=e907534017)
Steil for Wisconsin, Inc. * 1818 Milton Ave # 1448 * Janesville, WI 53545-1129 * USA

name: Jameson Ellis
subject: Are we being exploited, Peter?
body:
Let's explore the possibility.

| | | |
---
Peter,
You will receive the full details of the **General Flynn** event later this evening or tomorrow, so stay tuned...
If you know me well enough, you know that I try not to inundate your inbox with useless junk. Instead, I typically send emails only when they are essential.
This subject fits that category, and I'd like to address the elephant in the room (no pun intended).
Two days ago, a supporter sent a video of the House Freedom Caucus commenting on the "Swamp Omnibus" that passed the House. This supporter told me to fast-forward to Eli Crane's comments.
I love Rep. Eli Crane and look forward to fighting alongside him in Congress if you elect me in two years.
Below is a short video of his message to the American people.
But before you check it out, I want to ask you a question: Are you shocked that Dan Crenshaw won this primary when so many people are waking up to his voting record?
Sure, we can blame issues at the polls, which are legitimate concerns. But at the end of the day, we came within roughly 9% of winning with less than **$30k**.
We should go deeper.
Are there people exploiting our district for profit?
**Let's explore this possibility.**
We fought extremely hard to win the 2024 Primaries and unseat Dan Crenshaw with very little help and very little money. We received some excellent endorsements and are set up well for a victory in 2026.
However, I couldn't help but notice the conservative influencers and talking heads complaining about Dan Crenshaw and creating viral videos. Still, they brought no solutions to the table, nor did they help those of us in the district unseat Crenshaw.
(Except for the Hodge Twins, who retweeted me numerous times and supported our efforts)
It begs the question:
Will conservative influencers and talking heads get behind us to unseat Crenshaw in 2026? Or will they continue to exploit our district for likes and clicks?
**Because that's what it feels like -_exploitation_.**
What are your thoughts?
After you **watch the video** below, I'd love to hear them.
[](https://jamesonellis.lt.acemlna.com/Prod/link-tracker?redirectUrl=aHR0cHMlM0ElMkYlMkZ5b3V0dS5iZSUyRmwxbl9ZbFJJdzVZJTNGc2klM0RkWUw1WlRaQ0w3d1llNV83&sig=GDFU2qxqAw5hoCN2E5osnTe3WEq2g9XYtcPLQ2cJSrcR&iat=1711468801&a=%7C%7C611311006%7C%7C&account=jamesonellis%2Eactivehosted%2Ecom&email=HceZmo7aaFLm8InIWAMySzCzmVGaNeYlRS5tiCOONFItsZjT%3A7LGDYcpt6hvbm44pCkMZVl5pt9bp6Bv6&s=cabcbe31a720242486b887158a77876f&i=242A280A1A2185)
_For Liberty,_

clean_body: Let's explore the possibility. | | | | Peter, You will receive the full details of the General Flynn event later this evening or tomorrow, so stay tuned... If you know me well enough, you know that I try not to inundate your inbox with useless junk. Instead, I typically send emails only when they are essential. This subject fits that category, and I'd like to address the elephant in the room (no pun intended). Two days ago, a supporter sent a video of the House Freedom Caucus commenting on the "Swamp Omnibus" that passed the House. This supporter told me to fast-forward to Eli Crane's comments. I love Rep. Eli Crane and look forward to fighting alongside him in Congress if you elect me in two years. Below is a short video of his message to the American people. But before you check it out, I want to ask you a question: Are you shocked that Dan Crenshaw won this primary when so many people are waking up to his voting record? Sure, we can blame issues at the polls, which are legitimate concerns. But at the end of the day, we came within roughly 9% of winning with less than $30k. We should go deeper. Are there people exploiting our district for profit? Let's explore this possibility. We fought extremely hard to win the 2024 Primaries and unseat Dan Crenshaw with very little help and very little money. We received some excellent endorsements and are set up well for a victory in 2026. However, I couldn't help but notice the conservative influencers and talking heads complaining about Dan Crenshaw and creating viral videos. Still, they brought no solutions to the table, nor did they help those of us in the district unseat Crenshaw. (Except for the Hodge Twins, who retweeted me numerous times and supported our efforts) It begs the question: Will conservative influencers and talking heads get behind us to unseat Crenshaw in 2026? Or will they continue to exploit our district for likes and clicks? Because that's what it feels like -exploitation. What are your thoughts? After you watch the video below, I'd love to hear them. The U.S. State Department has just proposed new regulations that _will cut off grants and contracts_ to Christian--and all faith-based--relief organizations that require their employees to share their faith and their religious values. That means that relief organizations like **Samaritan's Purse** , a Christian ministry that has helped millions worldwide since its founding in 1970 ... Humanitarian organizations like **World Vision** , which has supported children in need and empowered millions of people out of poverty for more than 70 years ... | | _**_Meet Tom Cotton_**_

Tom Cotton was born and raised on his family's cattle farm in Arkansas, served as an Army infantry officer in Iraq and Afghanistan, and is fighting for working Americans in the U.S. Senate.

The tragic attacks of September 11, 2001 occurred during Tom's final year of law school and changed his life's trajectory.

After clerking on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit and spending a short time in private law practice, he joined the United States Army as an Infantry Officer, spending nearly five years on active duty.

Between his two combat tours he served as a platoon leader with the Old Guard at Arlington National Cemetery, the unit responsible for military honors funerals.

Tom's military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal, Combat Infantry Badge, and Ranger Tab.

In the U.S. Senate, he's fighting the tough battles for Arkansans and Americans, and delivering real results. He knows that only the strong can survive in a dangerous world, and he's building a movement to make America strong again.

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87444/images/New%20Sewell%20Delegate%20Logo%20.png]
March Newsletter
Dear neighbors,
Happy Spring! It is great to see and speak with so many of you as I am out and about in the district. Thanks for your continued support and interest in what we do in Richmond.
I am glad to be back in Woodbridge and am excited to share information that impacts the district. This week, I will highlight how Prince William County is impacted by the state budget that is currently under review by Governor Glenn Youngkin and his staff, provide highlights of recent articles with focus on the last legislative session, and share local information about Prince William County that may be of interest.
Prince William County in the Budget
In my last newsletter, I gave you a detailed overview of the conference budget report that was sent to Governor Youngkin at the close of the General Assembly session. This week, I will highlight a few components of the conference budget that deal directly with Prince William County and may impact you.
The governor has until April 8th to review the conference budget and all outstanding bills which were passed by both the House of Delegates and the State Senate. In Virginia, the Constitution ensures that the language in the state budget overrides any existing Virginia law. This means that beyond simply allocating state funding in the budget there are “language only” budget items which tell state agencies how they may administer new and existing funding for programs. The funding discussed below is not yet set in stone, but we hope it will remain in the final budget bill which becomes law on July 1, 2024 unless otherwise noted.
Workforce Development: Item 103 #3c adds $100,000 to the Department of Housing and Community Development to deliver to Prince William County to support workforce development training programs in the eastern part of the county.
Firefighter Career Training: Item 124 #10c adds $50,000 in both the first and second year of the budget provided to Prince William County Public Schools for a Public Safety Training Center at Unity Reed High School, which prepares students for a career in fire fighting.
Healthcare Career Training for Members of the Immigrant Community: Item 331 #1c adds $2 million dollars in the first year of the budget for the Department of Social Services to administer funding for a healthcare worker training program for members of the immigrant community.
LPGA Solheim Cup Tourism Resources: Item 114 #3c adds $5,000,000 to the Virginia Tourism Authority to provide grants to Prince William County to address public safety and transportation services required for the domestic and international travelers attending the event.
PWC Local Department of Health: Item 278 #2c adds additional funds for the Virginia Department of Health to cover increases in rent for the Prince William County Local Department of Health.
UVA Health 3D Hologic Mammography Mobile Outreach Van: Item 279 #4c adds $500,000 for the purchase of a new mobile mammography van to provide cutting edge mammography services in the Prince William community.
Prince William County Crisis Receiving Center: Item 296 #1c adds $2.25 million in both the first and second year of the budget for funding of the Prince William County Crisis Receiving Center.
Nepali Community Center: Item 331 #7c adds $250,000 in the first year for the Nepali Community Center in Prince William County. The Nepali Community Center is a nonprofit that preserves and promotes Nepali identity, culture, languages, values, norms and manners through the organization, as well as maintain and operate Nepali American Community Center to facilitate social, educational, cultural, spiritual, and sports activities and programs aimed at promoting multiculturalism in Northern Virginia.
National Museum of Americans in Wartime: Item 371 #2c adds $5,000,000 in the first year to support infrastructure development for the National Museum of Americans in Wartime. As a condition of this appropriation, Prince William County is required to provide matching funds totaling $2.5 million.
Below are items in the budget which are not focused solely on Prince William County, but which many of you expressed interest in through email and phone calls during the legislative session.
The Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative (RGGI) is a multi-state market-based climate change mitigation tool which caps CO2 emissions and requires facilities which emit carbon dioxide to purchase allowances based on the quantity of their emissions. These funds are then reinvested by the state in energy efficiency improvements, clean energy, bill assistance, and other programs to deliver benefits to their communities. Virginia lawmakers voted to join RGGI in 2020 while Ralph Northam was governor. In 2023, Governor Glenn Youngkin sought to remove Virginia from RGGI through the State Air Pollution Control Board. This action is currently facing pending legal action, but I am proud that our conference budget also takes immediate action to reverse the removal of Virginia from RGGI. Budget amendment Item 366 #1c “requires the Commonwealth to rejoin the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative (RGGI) and directs the appropriate agencies to take the necessary actions to rejoin RGGI.” You can learn more about RGGI at www.rggi.org [https://www.rggi.org/] and read more about the RGGI language in the budget on page 272 of the HB30 conference report found at budget.lis.virginia.gov/amendments/2024/1/ [http://budget.lis.virginia.gov/amendments/2024/1/] .
Developmental Disability Waivers are waivers granted by the Commonwealth of Virginia and authorized by the federal Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) which allow the state to fund certain community-based alternatives to institutional care. There are currently 3,440 people on the priority one waiver waiting list who urgently need access to funding for care or will face immediate risks to their health and safety within the next year. Thousands more remain on priority two and three waiting lists. This year’s budget includes funding to iteratively increase the capacity of service providers for these waivers by increasing reimbursement rates, while rolling out waivers to clear the entire priority one waiting list. You can learn more about DD Waiver services through the Department of Behavioral Health and Developmental Services here [https://dbhds.virginia.gov/developmental-services/waiver-services/] , and learn more about the push to fully fund these waivers in this year's budget via Cardinal News here [https://cardinalnews.org/2024/02/07/youngkins-plan-funds-care-for-people-with-the-most-serious-developmental-disabilities-the-rest-will-be-left-waiting/] .
Monumental Stadium funding has been taken out of the final conference report passed by the Senate and House of Delegates.
General Assembly News
Here are some headlines from the end of the general assembly session.
New look General Assembly heads home after 60 long days [https://richmond.com/news/state-regional/government-politics/general-assembly-taxes-youngkin-senate-arena/article_609bae5c-de66-11ee-938b-fba0e00b3374.html#tracking-source=home-top-story] | Richmond Times Dispatch
At the end of a long 60 days — days that regularly stretched beyond 12 hours and that often featured sharp differences of views — Virginia’s legislators left Richmond in the usual way Saturday: busily plowing through dozens of bills, voting on a budget and thanking staff members.
27 reasons why the General Assembly session mattered [https://richmond.com/news/state-regional/government-politics/general-assembly-youngkin-arena-taxes-abortion-cannabis/article_6a983326-dbdc-11ee-975d-f7293263a96d.html#tracking-source=home-top-story] | Richmond Times Dispatch
Now that the General Assembly‘s 60-day regular session is over, Gov. Glenn Youngkin‘s views on law, policy and spending will come to the fore as he prepares to act on hundreds of bills and tries to revive his proposed tax cuts and $2 billion Alexandria arena project.
General Assembly adjourns after passing $188 billion biennial budget [https://cardinalnews.org/2024/03/09/general-assembly-adjourns-after-passing-65-5-billion-biennial-budget/] | CardinalNews
The budget includes more than $2.5 billion in new funding for K-12 public education, a 3% salary increase for teachers and state employees, $2.5 million for a proposed inland port and $70 million for an Interstate 81 widening project.
Community Resources and News
Summer Camps: Trying to figure out what your kids will be up to this summer? Check out these great resources from Prince William County Parks and Recreation. You can learn more about PWC Parks & Rec summer camp resources here [https://www.pwcva.gov/department/childrens-programs/summer-camps] and can see a comprehensive list of all summer camps here [https://www.pwcva.gov/department/childrens-programs/summer-camps] .
Public Input on Proposed Indoor Sports & Events Center: The Prince William County Sports and Event Center is a proposed large indoor multi-sport and special event facility, that if ultimately approved, will be developed in North Woodbridge. You can learn more about the project here [https://www.pwcva.gov/department/parks-recreation-tourism/indoor-sports-events] . Residents of Prince William County are invited to attend the following community meetings to learn more about the project and provide feedback:
Community Meeting #1 on Wednesday, April 10, 2024 from 6:30 – 8:30 pm at the Pat White Center at Ben Lomond (10501 Copeland Dr., Manassas, VA 20109).
Community Meeting #2 on Thursday, April 11, 2024 from 6:30 – 8:30 pm in the Freedom High School Cafeteria (15201 Neabsco Mills Rd, Woodbridge, VA 22191).
If you are unable to attend one of these community meetings in person, you are invited to provide public comment on the bottom of this page [https://www.pwcva.gov/department/parks-recreation-tourism/indoor-sports-events] .
Tax Support through VITA: The Volunteer Income Tax Assistance (VITA) Program provides free tax preparation services to individuals and families with low income in the Northern Virginia community. If you or your family earned less than $60,000 in 2022, you may qualify for this free service! Find more information here: https://vcwnorthern.com/wp-content/uploads/2024-VITA-Tax-Season-Flyer-rev011024.pdf [https://vcwnorthern.com/wp-content/uploads/2024-VITA-Tax-Season-Flyer-rev011024.pdf]
National Park Service Awards Virginia $75,000 to Produce Historic Context on African American Schools: The Department of Historic Resources (DHR) will use the funds, which were allocated as part of the National Park Service (NPS) 2023 Underrepresented Communities Grant Program, to develop an African American Schools Multiple Property Document and to nominate an associated property to the National Register of Historic Places. Learn more here about the grant program here: https://www.nps.gov/subjects/historicpreservationfund/underrepresented-community-grants.htm [https://www.nps.gov/subjects/historicpreservationfund/underrepresented-community-grants.htm]
Stay In Touch
Let me know what events are taking place in your community and invite me to attend and to speak. You can email my team at DelBSewell@house.virginia.go [DelBSewell@hous.virginia.gov] v or call us at 703-261-4787. We look forward to hearing from you, and please stay tuned as we continue to provide important updates about what’s going on in Prince William County, and what happens between now and the reconvene session.
In service,
Briana Sewell

In the world of cryptocurrencies, Bitcoin has long been the dominant player, while Dogecoin has emerged as an alternative. There are several key reasons why Bitcoin is considered a better investment than Dogecoin.
**Market Capitalization and Adoption**
Bitcoin has a much larger market capitalization than Dogecoin, with a market cap of over $1 trillion as of 2024. This means that Bitcoin is more widely adopted and recognized by merchants and businesses around the world. In contrast, Dogecoin's market cap is significantly smaller, at $17.8 billion. This smaller market cap makes Dogecoin more susceptible to price fluctuations and volatility.
**Limited Supply and Scarcity**
One of the main reasons Bitcoin is considered a better investment is its limited supply. There will only ever be 21 million Bitcoin in existence, which creates a sense of scarcity and helps to maintain its value over time. In contrast, Dogecoin has an inflationary supply model, with 10,000 new coins being issued **every minute**. This unlimited supply means that Dogecoin will struggle to maintain its value over the long term.
**Technological Superiority and Development**
Bitcoin's underlying technology is more advanced and secure than Dogecoin's. Bitcoin uses a proof-of-work (PoW) consensus algorithm, which requires miners to solve complex mathematical problems to validate transactions and add new blocks to the blockchain. This process is more secure and energy-intensive than Dogecoin's mining process, which relies on a simpler algorithm.
Additionally, Bitcoin has a larger and more active development community, which is constantly working to improve the technology and address any issues that arise. This commitment to innovation and development makes Bitcoin a more attractive investment for the long term.
**Institutional Adoption and Mainstream Acceptance**
Bitcoin has seen significant adoption by institutional investors and large corporations, such as Tesla and MicroStrategy. This institutional adoption has helped to legitimize Bitcoin and increase its credibility as an investment. In contrast, Dogecoin has not seen the same level of institutional adoption, which may limit its growth potential.
**Price Stability and Volatility**
While both Bitcoin and Dogecoin can be volatile, Bitcoin is generally considered to be more stable than Dogecoin. This is due to its larger market cap, limited supply, and widespread adoption. While Dogecoin has seen significant price increases in recent years, it is also more susceptible to price fluctuations and market manipulation.
In conclusion, Bitcoin is considered a better investment than Dogecoin for several reasons. These include its larger market cap, limited supply, technological superiority, institutional adoption, and price stability. While Dogecoin received some positive press when Elon Musk hinted his approval, Bitcoin remains the dominant player in the world of cryptocurrencies and is the better investment for the long term.
_**PS - I have no history of making good investments, this is not investing advice just my opinion on current events and what is happening in our world.**_

subject: MAGA wants to gut Medicare and Social Security? Believe it.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOHN AVLON FOR CONGRESS
body:
Friends,
Elections are about contrasts, and this one has never been clearer.

Trump just floated raising the retirement age for Social Security. So what did his flunkies in the MAGA House do? They saw him and raised it. They just put out a budget that would hurt working families by cutting Medicare and Social Security. That’s not all: their same budget doesn’t do a damn thing to restore state and local tax deductions.

It’s not fair or fiscally responsible to screw working families and the middle class out of money they already paid into the system to fund their retirement. That’s why the budget that Nick LaLota and the rest of the MAGA extremists just put out should be a firing offense. And that’s not even counting the fact that they’re actually trying to cut funding for law enforcement. Talk about defunding the police.
This election is a choice. A choice between common sense or chaos. A choice between strengthening the middle class or scapegoating it.

That’s why it's time for everyone to get off the sidelines. Every one of us needs to stand up and commit to doing everything we can. I talk about fighting the good fight. This is it. I'm all in. Are you? Add your name and let's show Nick LaLota and the other Trump-flunkies there are more of us than them. [https://www.johnavlon.com/allin]

When people show you who they are, believe them. Trump already tried to destroy our democracy once. Now they’re saying they will gut Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid. Those are Trump values. Not Suffolk County values.

We’ve got to increase the quality of life for working families while reducing the cost of living. That’s how we’ll strengthen the middle class - working together to find common sense solutions, not bowing to Trump and his MAGA extremists.

The path to winning back the House runs straight through New York's First District, but it's going to take every single one of us. I need to know if you're with me. Add your name now >>
Thank you, as always, for fighting the good fight.

-John

Peter,

The FEC deadline at the end of this month is a BIG deal — it sets the tone for our entire year ahead and helps us determine how effectively we can support our endorsed Black candidates up and down the ballot and mobilize voters come Election Day.
