name: Sam Brown
subject: It sucks, Friend. It really does.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sam Brown for Nevada
body:
“Dad, when are you getting home?”

| | |
---
It sucks, Friend. It really does. I’ve been on the road for months, crisscrossing the state. All the while, my kids are texting me, asking me when I’ll be home. But the truth is this: I’m not running for office for the status. I’d prefer to lead a private life, raise my kids, and go out on a date with my wife every once in a while. I’m not running for office for the money. I’m a successful small businessman and would be better off financially if I didn’t run for anything. And I’m not running for office because it’s fun or easy. Running for office is one of the hardest things I’ve ever had to do – since I launched my campaign I’ve had to watch my kids grow up a lot without me. But our country needs leaders who know what it means to sacrifice. And I’m running for Senate to fill that void. **_[_Can I count on your support?_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z2t9af900n0j6ndvc405kj6ju075vjhlmhnqsgo8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34c5jm4ob2cph2bs)_ ** Joe Biden, Chuck Schumer, and the radical left have lost their minds. They’re putting illegal immigrants over veterans. They’re putting criminals over law abiding citizens. They’re injecting woke ideology into every facet of our military. When people ask me why I’m running my genuine response is: “I didn’t have a choice. It’s my lifelong, sacred duty to defend this country.” Chuck Schumer has a $37+ million dollar war chest ready to defeat me and end my campaign. I’m on a mission to bring a new generation of Conservative leadership to the U.S. Senate – and put an END to the limp-wristed insanity of the Biden/Schumer regime. But without your support, all the blood, sweat, and tears my family and I have poured into this campaign could go to waste. _**[_**Please, if you could, chip in a donation to my campaign today?**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zut1ro6gbk12kug7t77soprft47c4kmni4hqk4hg_rp22sh2s8i6ep34c5jm4ob2cph2bs)**_ The one bright spot is that I get to talk to God-fearing American patriots every day. Thank you so much for all you do for our great country. Duty First, CPT Sam Brown
---

name: Sam Brown
subject: It sucks, Friend. It really does.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sam Brown for Nevada
body:
“Dad, when are you getting home?”

| | |
---
It sucks, Friend. It really does. I’ve been on the road for months, crisscrossing the state. All the while, my kids are texting me, asking me when I’ll be home. But the truth is this: I’m not running for office for the status. I’d prefer to lead a private life, raise my kids, and go out on a date with my wife every once in a while. I’m not running for office for the money. I’m a successful small businessman and would be better off financially if I didn’t run for anything. And I’m not running for office because it’s fun or easy. Running for office is one of the hardest things I’ve ever had to do – since I launched my campaign I’ve had to watch my kids grow up a lot without me. But our country needs leaders who know what it means to sacrifice. And I’m running for Senate to fill that void. **_[_Can I count on your support?_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zk4hl5cbjs690q62f009ej2skmpsarf44gd87hp8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34c5jm4ob2c1h2bs)_ ** Joe Biden, Chuck Schumer, and the radical left have lost their minds. They’re putting illegal immigrants over veterans. They’re putting criminals over law abiding citizens. They’re injecting woke ideology into every facet of our military. When people ask me why I’m running my genuine response is: “I didn’t have a choice. It’s my lifelong, sacred duty to defend this country.” Chuck Schumer has a $37+ million dollar war chest ready to defeat me and end my campaign. I’m on a mission to bring a new generation of Conservative leadership to the U.S. Senate – and put an END to the limp-wristed insanity of the Biden/Schumer regime. But without your support, all the blood, sweat, and tears my family and I have poured into this campaign could go to waste. _**[_**Please, if you could, chip in a donation to my campaign today?**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zt2li153h3bv5777p1mesamrkbcjclhm88b0h3p0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34c5jm4ob2c1h2bs)**_ The one bright spot is that I get to talk to God-fearing American patriots every day. Thank you so much for all you do for our great country. Duty First, CPT Sam Brown

“Dad, when are you getting home?”

| | |
---
It sucks, Friend. It really does. I’ve been on the road for months, crisscrossing the state. All the while, my kids are texting me, asking me when I’ll be home. But the truth is this: I’m not running for office for the status. I’d prefer to lead a private life, raise my kids, and go out on a date with my wife every once in a while. I’m not running for office for the money. I’m a successful small businessman and would be better off financially if I didn’t run for anything. And I’m not running for office because it’s fun or easy. Running for office is one of the hardest things I’ve ever had to do – since I launched my campaign I’ve had to watch my kids grow up a lot without me. But our country needs leaders who know what it means to sacrifice. And I’m running for Senate to fill that void. **_[_Can I count on your support?_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z32qa6q1ce018iqcav4l7isqi1pl677gh1q6q75o_rp22sh2s8i6ep34c5jm4ob4cjh2bs)_ ** Joe Biden, Chuck Schumer, and the radical left have lost their minds. They’re putting illegal immigrants over veterans. They’re putting criminals over law abiding citizens. They’re injecting woke ideology into every facet of our military. When people ask me why I’m running my genuine response is: “I didn’t have a choice. It’s my lifelong, sacred duty to defend this country.” Chuck Schumer has a $37+ million dollar war chest ready to defeat me and end my campaign. I’m on a mission to bring a new generation of Conservative leadership to the U.S. Senate – and put an END to the limp-wristed insanity of the Biden/Schumer regime. But without your support, all the blood, sweat, and tears my family and I have poured into this campaign could go to waste. _**[_**Please, if you could, chip in a donation to my campaign today?**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zumg3d2usjh6t3ouqilj3rlq5115434cjtshnldg_rp22sh2s8i6ep34c5jm4ob4cjh2bs)**_ The one bright spot is that I get to talk to God-fearing American patriots every day. Thank you so much for all you do for our great country. Duty First, CPT Sam Brown

name: Chairman Eric Underwood
subject: ☕Coffee w/ the Chairman
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE REPUBLICAN PARTY of NEBRASKA ()
body:
🌽The Nebraska Good Life

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/b06884f175e4/n41kepo7ku-12687918?e=25844e23a8)
https://ne.gop/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=768f37b94e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-768f37b94e-21732365

** Good Morning Republicans,
------------------------------------------------------------
The Good Life. This used to be Nebraska's tourist slogan until somewhere a "focus group" thought it was a good idea to change it to "Nebraska, it's not for everybody". What a dumb slogan. Why would anyone who's lived in Nebraska for any length of time believe that this was a "great" idea? The Good Life...I think that was a GREAT slogan for Nebraska. It was positive, not divisive. It was optimistic and created an identity to the type of life ANYONE could have here IF they worked for it. Take a step back for a moment and let's dive into what words and ideas really mean or do for a culture or community. I think if you close your eyes for a moment and remember Good Times in Nebraska, Good Moments of your life...music from an era of your life...you would and could associate those memories with where you were at ... in Nebraska.
I remember living out in the country and only having the 8 wonder channels for t.v.
I remember watching M*A*S*H reruns, and listening to my parent's music of Elvis, old westerns, and good wholesome movies in the movie theaters.
I remember where I was when the Challenger exploded in 1986.
I remember driving home on family winter vacations, during every Nebraska bowl game it seemed, listening on the radio to the play-by-play. Rushing in the door to turn on NBC, the 1995 Orange Bowl and watching Cory Schlesinger's two Fullback touchdowns. National Champions.
I remember the setting sun during the Friday Night football games and the sweet smell of the grass field.
I remember country music and the songs from Garth, Fishin' in the Dark, Brooks and Dunn, Alan Jackson.
I remember my first job and earning money to drive my 1957 Chevy which I fixed up with Dad.
I remember the lessons from Dad about cars, and working on the acreage, fixing things and knowing how things work.
I remember the early 2000's and where I was in life when 9/11 happened. I remember it seemed PERFECT that the Patriots won the Superbowl that year.
All this was the "Good Life" in Nebraska. I would venture you have many, many more memories in just the same way. But, what I don't remember at all, even during most of my adult life... I don't remember the "politics". I don't remember the weight of this political landscape that has changed so dramatically since 2020. In today's world... EVERYTHING is political. You simply cannot escape it. From taxation, to education, to inflation, immigration, election honesty, freedoms ... it just feels like we are in a world of no TRUTH and no SOLUTIONS. It's as if every one of our Platform Values is being attacked. Which makes me wonder if most Republicans have even read our Platform or studied the National version.
I don't know what happened to the Republic that we are supposed to keep, according to Benjamin Franklin. A representative, democratic model versus the tyranny of a monarchy. I am perplexed as I watch identity politics play out in Nebraska, where good people will choose personalities over the values of the party. The sermon this holy week at my church was on how many of the religious leaders, like the Sadducee, use common words of faith but twist them for power, money, and influence the "will" of the people by using fear and guilt. I wonder how many times I've heard common conservative words and promises from even our own Republicans across America, implied as a foundation to a candidate's beliefs, but then we see the moral and ethical compromise because WINNING was more important (or power, money and influence). Then fear and guilt is heavily laid upon voters and constituents if THEY then choose to follow their morals and ethics. Who's integrity and character is really in question then; the
candidates or the voters? We always criticize the voters, when it's the candidate who has slid down a moral gray scale.
Yet we, as Nebraskans, persist through the political landscape because we WANT the Good Life back. We want to NOT have to think about politics again. We don't want to go to School Board meetings to get pornography, or SEL, or other non-academic indoctrination away from our kids. We don't want to go to City Council meetings because roads aren't being fixed, and police departments aren't being funded, but we get Green New Deals, electric gov't vehicles, and bloated bureaucracies. We don't want to have to get PINK taxation slips and go fight to lower our property taxes or file paperwork every year with an Assessor or County Clerk on our valuations.
And this is why we must say...enough is enough. We must prepare. We must be proactive in seeing a year's worth of outcomes and putting into motion the effort needed to be ready. I mentioned I have been to Keith County and Seward County conventions and this last week I went to Saunders County (such an impressive turnout). I am so proud of the leaders within our party who are also working TOGETHER to prepare counties. Our Legislative Director, William Feely has traveled to 15 County Conventions, looking to go to about 10 more, and helped out by being on the ballot committees or was a featured speaker. Fanchon Blythe, our National Committeewoman, has been to 10+ County Conventions and helped with credentials or ballot committees or just to support. Dave Plond, our Treasurer from Grand Island has traveled to several conventions. Dixon County has helped Seward County, Sarpy has helped Saunders, great conventions in Furnas, Adams, Cass, Cedar, Cherry, Clay, Fillmore, York, Thurston, Stanton,
Pierce, Perkins, Otoe, Lincoln, Knox, Kearney, Hooker, Holt, Greeley, Gage and so many MORE...WOW...the amount of TEAMWORK from so many counties to each other is absolutely unprecedented. The stability and growth in our county parties is HISTORIC and I'm so proud of the many new leaders in these counties for stepping up. At our State Convention in May, it will be an honor to highlight all our great counties and leaders.
It's time to get involved.
It's time to join your county party.
It's time to see the stability that is the NEW Republican Party of Nebraska
It's time for you to make a difference.
We need to understand that we took some of the largest leaps through creating a new culture and business model for political parties. You all did this and the other States have noticed. We used to live in what I call the "Nebraska Political Bubble" for the last 20-30 years. Nebraska has stayed archaic in building relationships at the door with voters. We've attempted to rebuild those voter relationships just in the 6-8 months prior to each November election and then cut off ties with voters until the next election cycle. NOW, we have the leaders, the volunteers, the RESOURCES, to turnout the voters in 2024.
But here's the KEY part to this new Relationship model, this is so, so CRITICAL to understand...voters TRUST has to be EARNED by doing what we SAY we are going to do as an Elected Official. No more excuses. No more freebies. No more "I'll do it next time." There is no more NEXT TIME. America, Nebraska, our small towns, are at the brink. We need BOLD leaders driven by courage to do what's right, RIGHT NOW.
Whatever you do...DON'T wait for someone else. You are who God is calling to make a difference.
Our State Convention is May 18th and we have an awesome Featured Speaker - Lt. General Michael Flynn! We will be showing his movie "Flynn - Deliver the Truth. Whatever the Cost." on Friday night, May 17th including a Q&A session

Friday, May 17^th Lincoln, NE
5:00pm Doors open

We also have AMAZING Sponsorship opportunities to showcase your business and brands both at our State Convention and National Convention events. These sponsorship's will highlight your company in front of 1000's of Nebraskans and can help gain access to exclusive networking in Milwaukee with key leaders from across the country!
We have plenty of work to do with Legislation Support, support of candidates, connecting to coalition partners, event planning, and discussing the different committee's and groups need to be successful in 2024!
The truth shall set us free.
Blessings,
–Chairman Underwood

That means you and I will have just eight months to build a 58-county, grassroots campaign capable of defeating Adam Schiff - with his ActBlue allies and the war chest he's assembled during the two decades he spent in Washington, D.C. There's no time to lose. With every day that goes by, you and I are getting more and more reminders why it's so important we win this election. The reality is present-day America is starting to look a lot like 1970s America. You remember what it was like: ► Not only were gas prices sky high, Carter's rationing meant we could only buy gas on even or odd days depending on our license plate numbers. Remember? ► Eleven Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village in Munich by terrorists. Remember? ► Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists in Iran. Remember?? Democrat policies had brought America to its knees. And now, as Yogi Berra used to say, "It's deja vu all over again." Joe Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don't care one bit that Americans are having a hard time. I'd go even further to say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and dependent. You and I must win this race. | | Sincerely, | | Steve Garvey #6 | | | | | PAID FOR BY STEVE GARVEY FOR U.S. SENATE PO Box 532389 Los Angeles, CA 90053-2389 |

All the way back in 1870, Hiram Rhodes Revels, a pastor and State Senator from Mississippi, was elected as the first Black US Senator. Since then, we've come a long way as a country. **But representation – like our democracy – is a work in progress, and I believe we can do better.**

Black Americans have long faced far too many obstacles like: discrimination, lower pay, higher job instability – not to mention the racist voter suppression laws that Texas Republicans like Ted Cruz have championed, which make it harder for certain folks to vote.

| Dear Friends and Neighbors,

It’s tax season again, and Americans across the country are gathering receipts, filling out forms, and staying up late to meet the upcoming April 15 deadline. Here are a few facts about our income tax system from the non-partisan Tax Foundation ([here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=a21eaf1345&e=1090c5c412)).
* The average income tax rate is 14.9 percent
* The top 50 percent of taxpayers paid 97.7 percent of all income taxes
* The top 1 percent of taxpayers paid 45.8 percent of all income taxes

Middle class taxpayers and small business owners carry the weight of the U.S. income tax system upon their shoulders. But it’s not just the high rates that are overbearing. The system is far too complex.

During the Covid lockdown, my three teenage sons, Will, Jake and Eli, were worried about earning enough money to pay their bills, so they started a landscaping business. They worked hard all summer clearing brush, picking weeds, and laying mulch to earn $4,600 in profits on $7,600 in sales. All was good. Then it came time to file their taxes.

Even though I had been in business for years, I didn’t know how to prepare tax forms for a three-person limited liability company. My sons and I spent a couple of days reading through complex IRS documents until we just gave up and called an accountant. After a few days, he delivered 132 pages of tax forms and filings and a $1,000 invoice. My teenage sons spent 21 percent of their profits on tax compliance for a summer landscaping business.

That’s the problem with our tax system. It makes things far too difficult for ordinary people to start a company and serve their customers. It incentivizes people to operate off the books using illegal labor and unsafe practices. And it makes law-abiding citizens vulnerable to aggressive enforcement of tax provisions that they don’t even understand.

Small businesses are hit exceptionally hard. They don't have teams of accountants on staff to fill out complicated forms. The same people clearing the brush are filing the taxes.

And, unlike big corporations that pay a maximum federal rate of 21 percent, small business owners pay a maximum rate of 37 percent, or more. That makes it extremely difficult for entrepreneurs to accumulate capital to reinvest in their businesses and create good jobs. It also creates a big disadvantage for small manufacturers who want to sell their products overseas.

I’ve been a small business owner for 19 years, and I’ve personally experienced the strains of excessive taxes and complex rules weighing on my company’s growth. My taxes are 181 pages this year. It’s outrageous.

In Congress, I’ll work to reduce income tax burdens on the middle class and small business owners. That will create and sustain good jobs right here in Pennsylvania, something I've already been doing for almost two decades.

**Keep America Free.**

_Kevin Dellicker is a Republican from Heidelberg Township, Lehigh County, running for U.S. House of Representatives in Pa.’s 7th District. He is a 28-year military veteran, technology company owner, husband and father. He’s not a career politician. He’s a proven leader with the experience and courage to Keep America Free. Learn more at[www.dellickerforcongress.com](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=fadd716ec8&e=1090c5c412)._

I’m proud to serve as the only Jewish woman in the U.S. Senate, and my faith has always been central to my work to bring positive change to communities in Nevada and across the country.
**Senator Schumer said it best:** Right now, I need all the help I can get as Republicans do everything they can to flip my seat red – and the Senate along with it.

Friend,

I grew up in Brooklyn as the son of an exterminator and a stay-at-home mom, and a descendant of victims of the Holocaust. My friend Jacky Rosen grew up in a working-class family as the granddaughter of Jewish immigrants and the daughter of a World War II veteran.
Today, I have the great privilege and responsibility of serving as the first Jewish Senate majority leader in our nation’s history, and Jacky is the only Jewish woman currently serving in the U.S. Senate.
**Don’t ever tell me that things can’t change.**

Our humble origins and shared Jewish faith are at the core of what motivates our work together in the Senate. Every day, we’re fighting to make progress on the real issues Americans face: lowering everyday costs for families, combating hate and discrimination, and restoring reproductive freedom.
But the GOP has a different vision for America, which is why they’re trying to defeat Jacky and enact their toxic agenda.

Right now, Republicans are targeting Jacky’s seat in battleground Nevada as the key to Senate control. Mitch McConnell personally selected an extreme GOP opponent to run against her, and he just set a new fundraising record. Donald Trump has been campaigning aggressively in Nevada to rally support from his MAGA base.
**We can’t let the only Jewish woman serving in the Senate stand against the full force of the GOP alone. But with polling showing Jacky tied neck and neck with her opponent right now, she needs all the help she can get to fight back. That’s why I’m personally reaching out to ask for your support:**
**[Will you please join me in supporting Jacky's reelection campaign by giving $5 or more now? Every dollar will make a critical difference in keeping Nevada blue, defending our Senate majority, and ensuring that Jacky and I can both continue making progress for the American people.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81676846/463184823/1553268835?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3607-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZDE4OTUyMC03OWViLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=r--j88AxYJ2kwt3IRR0_65gs0ZXmq_EbyGkC0MOPUcg=)**
Thank you for your support, friend.

Chuck Schumer
Senate Majority Leader

The Supreme Court will start hearing arguments in the case to ban abortion medication today — all thanks to Josh Hawley.
#
Peter — today is the day the Supreme Court will start hearing arguments in the case to ban the most commonly used abortion pill, mifepristone, nationwide.
**This radical out-of-touch lawsuit was first ruled on by a campaign donor Josh Hawley made a federal judge (and picked to oversee the case through “judge shopping”). It’s being led by Josh Hawley’s wife. And it’s even been directly supported by Josh Hawley’s taxpayer-funded role as U.S. Senator.**
**[CHIP IN TO FIGHT BACK »](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44752?refcode=em20240326-5131&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5131%2E614464%2El6fLDu)**
They’ve been working toward this moment since 2019, when Josh Hawley was sworn into the Senate and confirmed his donor, Matthew Kacsmaryk, to be a federal judge in the Northern District of Texas — even despite bipartisan opposition over his bizarre obsession with controlling other people’s bodies.
Alliance Defending Freedom, the organization where Josh Hawley’s wife works as lead counsel, knows that Kacsmaryk shares their extreme views on abortion and reproductive rights. So when they had a lawsuit, led by Josh Hawley’s wife, that aimed to restrict access to the abortion pill in all 50 states, they picked Matthew Kacsmaryk in the Northern District of Texas to be their judge.
It shouldn’t surprise anyone that Josh Hawley’s donor judge ruled in favor of the suit led by Josh Hawley’s wife — going against guidance from the FDA and reproductive health experts across the country.
Hawley later used his Senate office to file an amicus brief defending the ruling.
**This whole situation was so blatantly corrupt, that federal courts recently started efforts to prevent “judge shopping” on their own, as this case was one of the worst and clearest examples of this corruption to date.**

Control-obsessed elites like Josh Hawley are willing to do whatever it takes to strip away the essential freedom for everyday people to decide if and how they can build and raise their families.
Their first step was overturning Roe v. Wade. Now they’re attacking reproductive rights across the spectrum — from enacting Missouri’s exceptionless abortion ban, to outlawing the abortion pill across the country, and now restricting access to IVF.
**This election is our one and only opportunity to hold Josh Hawley accountable, and we can’t afford to waste it.[So Peter, will you help us get this message in front of Missouri voters by rushing a donation of $10 or whatever you can afford to my grassroots campaign today?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44752?refcode=em20240326-5131&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=5131%2E614464%2El6fLDu)**

Hawley later used his Senate office to file an amicus brief defending the ruling. Now they’re attacking reproductive rights across the spectrum — from enacting Missouri’s exceptionless abortion ban, to outlawing the abortion pill across the country, and now restricting access to IVF. This election is our one and only opportunity to hold Josh Hawley accountable, and we can’t afford to waste it. We need to build a campaign that has what it takes to fight back and win. Your support is how we do it.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1034%2E791427%2EE2hqJ3)

Hey team, it's Ilhan.
I'm writing this morning to ask you to **[make a contribution — of $3 or any amount possible — to our people-powered campaign for Congress. I hope you'll give me a chance to explain why.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-mar24.3mFzHz&refcode=em240326-1-t1&t=2&akid=1034%2E791427%2EE2hqJ3)
Here's the deal:
This Sunday night, our campaign is facing the first official FEC fundraising deadline of this election year.
We've emailed about these FEC deadlines before, and I'm sure we're not the only campaign reaching out to you about them. They're at the end of every quarter — just four times a year — and are _incredibly_ important to our campaign's chances of success.
You see, shortly after the deadline ends on March 31, we're _legally required_ by the Federal Election Commission to report our fundraising numbers. That means how much money we've raised, how many individual contributions make up that amount... it'll all be publicly available for everyone to see. Good or bad, big or small, we'll report it.
And the truth is that a LOT of people will be paying attention to the numbers we report.
Our allies, our right-wing opponents, the media — they're ALL going to be checking the receipts to see how we're doing, because those numbers are taken as a measure of how strong our grassroots support is, both in Minnesota's 5th district and across the country.
This FEC deadline — the second-to-last one before ballots are cast in this primary — is an opportunity to show everyone just how powerful our movement is. And since we're funding this campaign _together_ , I'm counting on your support today.
So please. I'm asking:
**[Can you make your first contribution — of $3 or any amount you can — to stand with our campaign today? I'm writing this morning to ask you to Here's the deal: This Sunday night, our campaign is facing the first official FEC fundraising deadline of this election year. We've emailed about these FEC deadlines before, and I'm sure we're not the only campaign reaching out to you about them. They're at the end of every quarter — just four times a year — and are incredibly important to our campaign's chances of success. You see, shortly after the deadline ends on March 31, we're legally required by the Federal Election Commission to report our fundraising numbers. That means how much money we've raised, how many individual contributions make up that amount... it'll all be publicly available for everyone to see. Good or bad, big or small, we'll report it. And the truth is that a LOT of people will be paying attention to the numbers we report. Our allies, our right-wing opponents, the media — they're ALL going to be checking the receipts to see how we're doing, because those numbers are taken as a measure of how strong our grassroots support is, both in Minnesota's 5th district and across the country. This FEC deadline — the second-to-last one before ballots are cast in this primary — is an opportunity to show everyone just how powerful our movement is. Your Freedom of Faith
People of Faith are under attack by the DFL, they cannot really hide it anymore. There has long been a faith-based exemption to our discrimination laws when it comes to sexual orientation as long it is not pertaining to a normal secular business activity. With the new efforts to enshrine the entire string of people covered under the LGBTQIA+ umbrella (in this case specifically as it pertains to opinions on gender), they are also attempting to remove that faith based exemption. **At first conservatives assumed it was an oversight, not even the DFL would be that bold, would they? ** Well, this year it was confirmed that it was indeed intentional, and it was a direct attack on those houses of faith. What possible reason would someone who identifies as LGBTQIA+ have for even applying for a job such as teaching in a private religious school unless it is to undermine that organization? The hiring of that individual is directly contrary to the mission/beliefs of that organization. Efforts were made to add an amendment to the proposed law change to ensure that the faith based exception would still pertain to gender in the Senate, but it was to no avail. **The hearing in the DFL controlled committee pertaining to****the amendment was held at 1 AM, yes, that is not a misprint, 1 in the morning, most likely to limit coverage and discourage people from testifying**. The Committee voted 5-3 with all democrats present voting against the amendment. The government has no business in our religious lives and the U.S. Constitution forbids them from telling us what we can believe. We must fight these efforts of the government to impose itself in our spiritual lives. A religious organization has a right to teach their faith and set the example of their faith without the government demanding they put someone who contradicts the teachings of their faith in a position that undermines their message and religion. Just being against this infringement is not enough, we need to educate people on what is going on so they understand, we need to make enough noise about these attacks on our constitution that it shines a light on these abuses. That is why you should elect me; I will do just that.

name: Conservative Intel
subject: The history of capitalism and socialism
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWU2zhtiN2

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWU2zhtiN2

Dear
Friend,
Over the
last century, free-market capitalism and socialism have provided
the dominant interpretations, and conflicting visions, of
political and economic freedom. In the past few years, we've seen
a growing trend among young Americans in favor of socialism and
against capitalism.

But do
they truly understand the history and outcomes of socialism and
capitalism?

This is
precisely why we put together this brand new eBook, The History
Of Socialism And Capitalism, from Hoover Institution senior
fellows Niall Ferguson and Victor Davis Hanson.

This
eBook consists of two papers-one from each scholar-written in
conjunction with The Human Prosperity Project on Socialism and
Free-Market Capitalism. This project provides objective and
scholarly analyses of free-market capitalism, socialism, and
hybrid systems and provides evidence on the effectiveness of the
various systems on outcomes that affect prosperity and
well-being.

I think
you will find this new eBook particularly important and timely,
given the recent interest in policies that are radical from a US
historical perspective, some of which are advocated by political
leaders.

Simply
click here to request your free copy of The History Of Socialism
And Capitalism.

Thanks,
Greg

Hoover Institution is a non-partisan, data-driven policy research
organization that seeks to improve the human condition by
advancing ideas that promote economic prosperity, national
security, and democratic governance. Over more than one hundred
years, Hoover's work has directly led to policies that have
produced greater freedom, democracy, and opportunity in the
United States and around the world.

Hi friends – got a second?
I have a quick update for you on our upcoming March FEC fundraising deadline.

Will you pitch in $25 – or whatever amount is meaningful to you – to help me reach my $10,000 goal before the March 31st deadline? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]

| | Within one week of announcing his campaign, my Republican opponent launched $2.5+ million worth of TV and digital ads to blanket Wisconsin and attempt to control the narrative in our race. For weeks, Eric Hovde had the airwaves to himself — putting our campaign in a difficult position. **That's why my campaign manager just gave the green light to increase our advertising budget for the month so we could launch our own TV and digital ads right away.** This was a tough decision to make. I know it carries a pretty big risk. But we didn't anticipate these so-called "ad wars" beginning so soon, and we certainly didn't expect Hovde to dump buckets of money into the race _this_ early. Look, TV ads aren't cheap — they're one of the most expensive line items on any campaign's budget, but they're also one of the most effective ways to win an election. That's why I'm telling you all of this. The decision may have blown a hole in the budget, but I felt confident taking the risk because this grassroots team has always had my back. ## **MISSISSIPPI MEDICAID EXPANSION GOP PRIMARY VOTER POLL RESULTS**
**A total of 625 voters were interviewed statewide by Mason-Dixon Polling & Strategy betweenFebruary 26 and March 1, 2024. All indicated they regularly vote in state primary elections and always choose the Republican primary ballot. The margin for error is +/- 4 percentage points.**
**QUESTION: In 2010, President Barack Obama pushed Obamacare through Congress. Republicans opposed the law. Do you believe Republicans were right or wrong to oppose Obamacare?**
* **Right to oppose 81%**
* **Wrong to oppose 7%**
* **Not sure 12%**

**QUESTION: Former President Trump recently said that Obamacare is not good and if he is elected President in 2024 he will repeal and replace it. Do you agree or disagree with President Trump that Obamacare should be repealed and replaced?**
* **Agree 90%**
* **Disagree 8%**
* **Not Sure 2%**

**QUESTION: A major part of the Obamacare law was expansion of Medicaid. The law allowed states to give Medicaid to able-bodied adults without children. Do you think Mississippi should or should not adopt Obamacare 's Medicaid expansion?**
* **Should 10%**
* **Should not 81%**
* **Not sure 9%**

**We recently broke the story about _PragerU_ ’s partnership with Arizona’s state superintendent.** The partnership could put pundits like Candace Owens and Tucker Carlson in classrooms across the state, indoctrinating our kids with right-wing propaganda.
[**We’ll talk more about it in a sec, but if you support rigorous local journalism like this, please consider giving $10 to fund our newsrooms!**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81696195/463240564/-593472309?refcode=20240326-EM-PragerUAZ&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDQ2NjdiZWEtOGZlYi1lZTExLWFhZjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=b8Ltmbnkaajp_BifMIHtk-ToTAZhrHymd3jMBkDmcX0=)

**Arizonans should know their kids may soon learn right-wing misinformation in public school classrooms.** But with local newsrooms shutting their doors or getting gobbled up by right-wing media conglomerates, trustworthy, local reporting is hard to come by.
**That’s why we were proud to be the first to break the story.**
While newsrooms around the country are pivoting to the right or closing their doors altogether, COURIER’s reporters cover the most important stories, focusing on the facts.
**We know how essential this coverage is, which is why COURIER is hiring more reporters to cover breaking news like this, and even opening another newsroom in Texas later this year.**

name: David Horowitz
subject: The plot to destroy Christian America
body:
| |
---
| | If you were a Christian that wanted to attend worship service in 2020, government officials treated you like a terrorist. If you were a criminal that assaulted innocent people, burned buildings to the ground and ransacked every business in your path, Leftists handed you the keys to the city. I’ll never forget what they did - _because if they had their way, they’d do it again._ They pretended it was about safety, but we both know that was a lie. It was about control. It was about their agenda. **And it was about their decades-in-the-making war on Christian America.** No matter what you believe or who you worship, this is your fight. You see, the radical Left is doing everything in their power to rip Christianity from our culture, because that’s where our freedoms, our rights, our liberties -- the values that have defined our nation -- came from. **[**I explain this at length in _Dark Agenda: The War to Destroy Christian America_.**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31245%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=n4MNEpIAMyaIkR9OHwew6Q&sysid=1)** My name is David Horowitz, and this might surprise you, but I’m not a Christian and I never have been. This isn’t about my personal beliefs, it’s about right versus wrong, good versus evil, and those who want to protect America versus those who want to destroy her. _And no one knows the Left better than I do - or how their hatred for America and their hatred for Christianity go hand in hand._ I spent decades entrenched in the radical Left before I saw them for who they really were. When I was a young man, I marched side by side with the Black Panthers and edited the leading Marxist magazine. I finally saw their true nature when they murdered my friend, so I cast my vote for Ronald Reagan in 1984 and I never looked back. **_All that to say I know the reason Leftist politicians hunted down churchgoers like enemies of the state while violent criminals roamed free in 2020._** It wasn’t negligence, coincidence, or incompetence. They want to tear Christianity and religion from our country because they want to replace God with government. They want you answering to the State and the State only. And they know if they can strip America’s religious foundation, they can finally shred our Constitution and destroy everything that made us who we are. **But this war is far from over, and I need you on my side.** **[That’s why I hope I can count on your generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to the David Horowitz Freedom Center today.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31246%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2fQ%2bL73tGQbtuMM5VDe1oQw&sysid=1)** I founded the Freedom Center because I was determined to expose everything I’d learned about the radical Left in the hopes that I could stop them in their tracks. Since then we’ve published thousands of articles, pamphlets, books and profiles - and we’ve changed hearts, minds and outcomes. The Left attacks us time and time again because they know just how effective we are. We’ve been targeted by MasterCard, Discover Card, the Ways and Means Committee, and most recently the IRS. But we won’t back down - no matter who comes after us. Because there is no nonprofit with a history like ours -- or more importantly, a knowledge like ours. There is no nonprofit with our expertise or understanding of the Left and its motives, or the track record we have to back it up. **[That’s why I hope I can count on your generous, tax-deductible gift of $35 or more today](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31247%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Q04BalgDH3hJv8yHa2bfNA&sysid=1) - and as a thank you for your support, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of _Dark Agenda: The War to Destroy Christian America._** Karl Marx said it himself: communism begins where atheism begins. Simply put, without Christianity, we have no country, and we have no future. But too many of our fellow citizens don’t understand what’s at stake, or exactly what we’re up against. And I need your help sounding the alarm. I hope I can count on you.
---
| | Sincerely,

I’m going head-to-head with Adam Schiff in November.Democrat policies have brought America to its knees.There’s fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. [**CHIP IN A DOLLAR OR TWO ->** ](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=fabc15fdb4cf4b019c32411b78566510&_e=6KI45lKj-5q14dzMHyH58fCT5V4HBMD-YBIFTa0KMsso27bFB1oSuC-ng1xt16DEjnoJ5glMLX44hfjw82R8N1Bqa07IXDpRb4iAcM7Gp_rkuya3pz1h_AIXOT6C_18NoHYO16x2sUNs9dKzyQQ_5cLzZEPdNbpHgpeYEHTXOgwDfgkz52m01p-qgf0q2lhp5SemkLlmh8pNRGMhhVtgZSzL5ZAMKqVmTd_ronlZrGqJUJuEo68tb1oYP11hNgW3ymJcafLdOn6z3D76ZmTVFOAMxChlOgt-dzvdj4Z2YAW56IrBQoJsKbbfGhRB2t-KkC7pfbrDQAOoadz-J9iWwzex96n6YQxbz51SJ1CXB82xYeZOsrozA-dYKYNiYLF4-10C8SYeSsBknm3d5l_irQ%3D%3D)

Fellow Conservative,

**I’ll keep this brief:** if we don’t get our online fundraising on track today, **[we won’t hit our goal before our March 31st](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=fabc15fdb4cf4b019c32411b78566510&_e=6KI45lKj-5q14dzMHyH58fCT5V4HBMD-YBIFTa0KMsso27bFB1oSuC-ng1xt16DEjnoJ5glMLX44hfjw82R8N1Bqa07IXDpRb4iAcM7Gp_rkuya3pz1h_AIXOT6C_18NoHYO16x2sUNs9dKzyQQ_5cLzZEPdNbpHgpeYEHTXOgwDfgkz52m01p-qgf0q2lhp5SemkLlmh8pNRGMhhVtgZSzL5ZAMKqVmTd_ronlZrGqJUJuEo68tb1oYP11hNgW3kLv_bB1ELMPflX7OurwkMsmHQdbgM4PKWgxgLhZ-stXR9v63sRZgpfg0qKTDRI8Wf67RoaaoZqOkkUhQveVJOVmb_kWCAesl26bcjhf6xXT-OzoqLdxrjKes5TRd0JZn1LtACcUSsDkvLncXBT5UOg%3D%3D)** end-of-quarter fundraising deadline.

_**I cannot emphasize enough**_ how bad this would be for my campaign, you, and the entire country.

We all knew that the first couple of months of the year would be consumed with presidential politics - but with President Trump having secured the nomination early this month, _**my team and I had high hopes that money would begin to flow into critical Senate races like mine.**_

**So far, that hasn’t happened, and as things stand right now, we’re still $92k+ short of hitting our email fundraising goal for the month.**

[**CHIP IN A DOLLAR OR TWO ->** ](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=fabc15fdb4cf4b019c32411b78566510&_e=6KI45lKj-5q14dzMHyH58fCT5V4HBMD-YBIFTa0KMsso27bFB1oSuC-ng1xt16DEjnoJ5glMLX44hfjw82R8N1Bqa07IXDpRb4iAcM7Gp_rkuya3pz1h_AIXOT6C_18NoHYO16x2sUNs9dKzyQQ_5cLzZEPdNbpHgpeYEHTXOgwDfgkz52m01p-qgf0q2lhp5SemkLlmh8pNRGMhhVtgZSzL5ZAMKqVmTd_ronlZrGqJUJuEo68tb1oYP11hNgW3LI21wnjnPCvAGv7HL0BRAdF26b1fWf9bhfc-FFjPUWLbXpg_-A2w3_hUq0bcSCa0VlRpwv6FYBMO5i6uI32yig-77L9OH7Oh-e9K_nkteWWh9QrBohNlFrlm8eP4ylUNjI3gdSddjgeikPm6lh7DMw%3D%3D)

Here is why it’s critically important for you to take action today: _**From January to February, my opponent’s fundraising INCREASED by 31%, resulting in a net gain to his campaign of more than $400,000.**_

**[Can I get 100 of you reading this right now to chip in $31? body:

You've been told over and over in the media that foods like oatmeal and quinoa are good for you, and you should eat lots of them. But what most people don't realize is that these two particular foods contain compounds that can actually harm your health and your digestion in many ways...

And as your favorite Nutritionist, I'll explain why in this quick email, so you can avoid further harming your health and digestion with these so-called "healthy" foods...
**
1\. Oatmeal and Oat Milk**

While oatmeal is touted as a healthy carb and a source of fiber, unfortunately there are more cons than pros with this food...

The first problem with oats is that they are loaded with a compound called phytic acid (phytates) that significantly lowers your absorption of certain minerals and vitamins, such as calcium, magnesium, and zinc.

So whenever you eat oats, the phytic acid causes you to absorb less of these vitally important minerals which could cause health problems if you eat oats too frequently, since most people already don't get enough minerals like magnesium and zinc.

The second problem with oats is that they contain one of the highest residue concentrations of the **toxic herbicide glyphosate, which can damage your gut, and have been linked to other health problems like cancer** , hormone issues, and more.

The next major problem with oats is that they are a significant source of **mycotoxins** in the diet, which are mold based toxins that can cause an array of gut problems, hormone problems and more.

Lastly, oats can also contain high levels of the **toxic heavy metal** Cadmium, which is linked to health problems as this toxic heavy metal accumulates in your body.

**2\. Quinoa**

Quinoa is another food that is pitched as a health food or a "superfood". Unfortunately, this is another example of a food that has more downsides than good sides.

First off, quinoa is high in compounds called saponins, that have been shown in some studies to **cause gut damage and contribute to "leaky gut".**

Another problematic compound in quinoa are lectins, which are a type of antinutrient that can **damage the cells of your intestines** , and contribute to several gut disorders and immune system problems.

Many friends and colleagues of mine have reported feeling abdominal pain after eating quinoa, bloating, and loose stools or diarrhea, as well as triggering of autoimmune conditions such as skin conditions.

Now let's take a look at a fun little quiz below and a few more foods...

**Broccoli vs Kale vs Green Beans... (the #1 WORST veggie for your gut & energy)**
According to the best-selling author and world-renowned heart surgeon, Dr. Steven Gundry, there's one veggie people over 40 should never eat.

This veggie can **damage your gut and disrupt your hormones...** It contains a toxin that damages the lining of your intestines, causes bloating, embarrassing gas, and a bulging belly.

Do you know the veggie I'm talking about? Make sure you do by clicking the one below you think it is, and get the answer from Dr. Gundry himself on the next page:

>> Broccoli

>> Kale

Today, the conservative Supreme Court that overturned _Roe v. Wade_ is hearing a case that could cut off access to mifepristone — a safe, effective, and FDA-approved abortion medication. Medications like mifepristone make up 63% of abortions nationwide, which is why Republicans want to make it extremely difficult to access _everywhere_. That includes states like New Mexico where abortion is legal. I’m fighting in the Senate to pass a resolution to defend access to medication abortion across the country and protect reproductive rights from the GOP’s escalating attacks. clean_body: Our volunteers are hitting the streets every single day to register people to vote across Texas. With no online or automatic voter registration in our state, the work they’re doing is key to bringing every Texan into our elections. As a grassroots organization, we’re counting on donations from supporters like you to make sure our volunteers have the supplies they need to register voters: clipboards, pens, water bottles, hand sanitizer, and more. To maintain their grip on power, Texas Republicans have made our state the toughest in the nation to register to vote. Every dollar you donate today will help our volunteers register, organize, and turn out the voters most targeted by GOP voter suppression. Can Beto count on you to pitch in $3 or whatever you can today? # [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=2457%2E552475%2ExUb1zF)
Peter — this is a longer email, but I wanted to give you a candid update on the state of the race and what we’re seeing on the ground in Pennsylvania.
I’ll get into more detail in a second, but here’s the TLDR: **If Bob loses here in PA, Democrats have no chance of holding the Senate and the White House.**
**Here’s an important update on the state of our race that I created for our team so you understand the stakes ahead of us — but if you’re ready to make a donation right now, you can do so here:[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240326-2](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240326-2?recurring=1&refcode=em20240326-2&refcode2=2457_552475_xUb1zF&akid=2457%2E552475%2ExUb1zF)**
_**Key Race Updates**_ **Polls are tightening.**
* A recent poll shows that our lead is slipping.
* Pennsylvania will be the tipping point that decides the Senate majority in November, and we simply cannot afford to fall behind.

**We are being outraised.**
* David McCormick outraised us last quarter, and a super PAC supporting him raised nearly $18 million so far.
* What’s more, David McCormick has the full support of national Republicans and out-of-state billionaires who are ready to flood PA with millions upon millions to flip this seat red.

**Billionaires are trying to buy this seat.**
* A dark money super PAC made a $1 million ad buy in PA to boost our opponent and attack Bob Casey.
* Our opponent and the National Republican Senatorial Committee just launched their first TV ad, with more likely to come.

**Political experts and news outlets across the country have identified our race as one to watch.**
* NBC’s Ali Vitali called this race “one of the most consequential re-election battles in the country.”
* MSNBC’s Joe Scarborough said the Pennsylvania Senate race will be the “showdown of showdowns” in 2024.
* The Cook Political Report identified Pennsylvania as one of Mitch McConnell’s top three targets.

**Pennsylvania is a key battleground.**
* The Commonwealth has a long history of deciding Presidential elections and Senate control.
* It happened in 2016, in 2020, and again in 2022.
* There’s no doubt in my mind that PA will once again be the linchpin that decides the Senate and the White House in 2024.

**David McCormick is wrong for Pennsylvania.**
* David McCormick lives in Connecticut and bragged about spending only half his time in the Commonwealth.
* As CEO of his hedge fund, he oversaw a 108,000% increase in investments in China.
* McCormick got rich by outsourcing jobs to China and India while laying off workers in Pennsylvania.

**What Comes Next:** We need the resources to fight back against the tsunami of GOP money headed our way and make the case to voters about the threat McCormick poses to PA. **[With that said, will you rush $5 to re-elect Bob and protect our narrow Senate Majority?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240326-2?recurring=1&refcode=em20240326-2&refcode2=2457_552475_xUb1zF&akid=2457%2E552475%2ExUb1zF)**

body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/official-newsletter-12687166?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
---
| | **WEEKLY UPDATE FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
| My Fellow Floridians,

Even though the legislative session is over and I am back home in the district, my days have been anything but boring. I have had many opportunities to attend events, give legislative updates, and visit with constituents. I love working hard for House District 24 in Tallahassee, but nothing beats being back in my community.

I appreciate you taking the time to read this update! Your continued trust and support mean a great deal to me. I look forward to keeping you updated on my work and activity out in the district in the months to come.
---
| | **Gov. Ron DeSantis Signs HB 1415**
---
|
---
| At the end of last week, Gov. Ron DeSantis signed my legislation to [extend peer support to correctional officers](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=f916e3ab06&e=d1c1b9864f) into law. I am grateful for the governor’s support on this bill. It is important to me that all first responders receive the physical, moral, and emotional support they need to continue serving and protecting our communities. It was an honor to carry [HB 1415](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=f60008a6cc&e=d1c1b9864f) during this year’s legislative session, and I look forward to the positive impact it will have on the first responder community in Florida.
---
| | **Awarded House Legislative Champion by the PBA Corrections Chapter**
---
|
---
|
---
---
| I am proud to share with the district that I received the House Legislative Champion Award from the Florida PBA Corrections Chapter for my work on [HB 1415](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=730fef7835&e=d1c1b9864f). I want to thank the chapter for recognizing my commitment to championing this important issue in the legislature. In Tallahassee, it was an honor to support Florida’s correctional officers, who are dedicated to maintaining public safety across our state. I look forward to being a voice for our first responders in the next legislative session.
---
| | **Gov. Ron DeSantis Signs HB 3**
---
|
---
| Yesterday, Gov. Ron DeSantis signed [HB 3](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=86594c8636&e=d1c1b9864f)! It was an honor to co-sponsor this great bill for our state during the legislative session. This measure prevents kids under 14 from holding a social media account and allows 14- and 15-year-olds to open an account with parental consent. Social media can destroy the lives of young kids, so it is up to us to protect them from these online dangers. I am proud of the Florida Legislature’s unified effort to make our state a place that prioritizes the mental health and safety of our children.
---
| | **Upcoming Events in House District 24**
---
| Over the next few weeks, I will be speaking at several events in the district. Below are some of the places where I will have the opportunity to discuss my work with the community.
* Ocala Tea Party Action’s “America First Rally”
* Stone Creek
* Oak Run
* Spruce Creek Preserve

Please keep an eye out for additional events and updates!
---
|
---
| | It is an honor to represent House District 24! The 2024 Legislative Session was one for the books, and I am incredibly grateful for the opportunity to serve my community. As always, if I may be of any assistance, please do not hesitate to contact my office by **[clicking here](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=4e750ee468&e=d1c1b9864f "https://www.myfloridahouse.gov/Sections/Representatives/contactmember.aspx?MemberId=4901&SessionId=103&utm_source=Ryan+Chamberlin+for+State+Representative&utm_campaign=ae0a433299-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_08_05_14_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-7ddd94a0de-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D")**.

Have a great week!

Best regards,

**Ryan Chamberlin**
******State Representative**
**District 24**
---

State Representative Ryan Chamberlin

1101 The Capitol

Tallahassee, FL 32399-1300

Shadowy groups spending billions. Back scratching. And an open conspiracy to ban abortion medication nationwide. It all hinges on a business arrangement that shouldn't even be legal. Here's how, thanks to Josh Hawley, they might get away with it. For now.
First, meet the judge. A fellow named Matthew Kacsmaryk gets tapped to be a federal judge, but his confirmation stalls out and faces bipartisan opposition due to his obsession with using the courts to control people's lives.
We later learned he even tried to hide how bad his record really was.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/44e326ef-4d24-4634-be63-f1a84b660041?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Tired of languishing as a nominee, Kacsmaryk decided to invest in his future. So, he donated to Josh Hawley, then a U.S. Senate candidate and a fellow member of a shadowy group of activist lawyers funded by billionaires and multinational corporations.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/beb20fa7-8165-4672-80fd-4bafde390525?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Then came the payout. Months later, Hawley, now a U.S. Senator, provided one of the decisive votes to confirm Kacsmaryk to the court, despite bipartisan opposition. For Kacsmaryk, the payout makes him the newest federal judge for the Northern District of TX.
> _" Senator Susan Collins issued a dire warning in 2019 about Judge Matthew Kacsmaryk, who on Friday temporarily halted the use of mifepristone, a pill used to terminate pregnancies._
_See:_ https://www.newsweek.com/susan-collins-dire-warning-about-matthew-kacsmaryk-proven-true-1793280
Now that the pieces were in place, more shadowy groups entered the scenes.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ecdff872-8d8e-4359-b589-54d26062ae1d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
One of those shadowy groups was Alliance Defending Freedom (ADF) -- another cohort of corporate-funded activist lawyers with a long history of connections to Josh Hawley. He's even taken their money.
In 2022, ADF wanted to file a lawsuit to ban an abortion pill millions already use safely. But first, they went "judge shopping" -- it's a blatantly corrupt practice where lawyers try to game the court so they can land a judge who's friendly to their cause.
> _" By filing the lawsuit in Amarillo, the cadre of anti-abortion groups seeking to cancel the FDA's approval of the drug virtually guaranteed Kacsmaryk would hear their case. Critics have accused the plaintiffs of targeting Kacsmaryk to preside over the case because he was seen as more sympathetic to their arguments that the drug, which was approved in 2000, has major safety concerns." _
See: https://www.cnbc.com/2023/04/12/abortion-pill-ruling-puts-judge-shopping-concerns-back-in-spotlight.html
With everything neatly arranged, ADF found its preferred judge in the Northern District Court of Texas: Matthew Kacsmaryk.
And who did they pay to lead their lawsuit? None other than Josh Hawley's wife.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/802d87e8-9680-4355-b9f0-d4185867cc35?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
That's the Josh Hawley family business.
Hawley's corruption was so obvious, that federal courts recently put forward new rules on how judges are selected for cases.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/507a2ba1-5486-44c6-b80f-1b3956507e08?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Now, Hawley and his allies are trying to [stop the efforts](https://substack.com/redirect/d6c24717-1edb-4018-bdd8-f90a77be4ca8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to restrict judge shopping.
You might think that's pretty bold considering the heat he's gotten. But Josh has already been so obvious about his efforts to corrupt our courts -- why stop?
Of course, Hawley's donor judge decided in favor of the lawsuit led by Hawley's wife.
His brazenly out-of-touch ruling ["filled with activists' language"](https://substack.com/redirect/e23805f8-00af-4d9b-8eaf-2f2f6ce6128f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) called for an immediate ban on mifepristone--the most commonly used abortion drug--in all 50 states.
**It 's the first time a federal judge has ever tried to take a drug off the market all by himself and over objections by almost everyone in medicine. **That's how far Hawley's corruption was able to push this conspiracy to control people's bodies.
And it brings the conspiracy to the top of the legal system, where Josh Hawley's wife will be fighting to get the Supreme Court to back this nationwide ban on the abortion pill.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d4f5c178-9259-4b3d-81a1-a58adc56d085?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I'm sure you'll be surprised to learn which U.S. Senator used his taxpayer-funded office to submit (another) amicus brief in support of this case.
That's right. Josh Hawley.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/91a3dafd-e495-4100-a8f3-4b0e36637a82?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
So if the Supreme Court blocks access to abortion medication, you have one man to thank: **Josh Hawley and his corrupt family business.**
Senators shouldn't be in the business of using their position to benefit their family's legal careers and activism, especially if there is a financial incentive to do so. And there shouldn't even be a hint of campaign donations impacting who, when, and how a judge gets on a court.
In the U.S. Senate, I'll vote to restore Roe. But I'll also fight for rules to end corruption like this in our courts. I'll file legislation to outlaw judge shopping for good, and to bar senators from voting on judicial nominees who've given to their campaigns.
###

body:

How can we address the issues facing Rural America?
To solve these problems, we must rely on more than money. We also need strong leadership and direction, but yes, it will absolutely require investments.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Our success requires investment, too. We are entirely reliant on grassroots support.
We are a campaign of, by, and for the people, and have an FEC fundraising deadline in 5 days. Every penny goes toward strengthening rural communities.
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will be processed immediately.
CONTRIBUTE $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=express_lane_10]
CONTRIBUTE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=25&refcode=express_lane_25]
CONTRIBUTE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=50&refcode=express_lane_50]
Friends,
What can the federal government do for rural Americans? My opponent would have you believe nothing, that we're on our own. But, if the government is truly of the people and by the people, strong leadership can help facilitate the hope required to move us forward.
First, we must secure funding for essential healthcare, education, and housing programs.
This is not a radical idea; it is how we built the middle class that made America the beacon of a collective dream, the American Dream.
People work hard and pay taxes, so they deserve efficient and effective solutions that can help them and their families thrive.
Second, we must focus on growing the middle class by serving hardworking individuals.
We also need to reinvent Rural America and make it a stable foundation for families and workers. We must offer livable wages and create a great place for Americans to live, work, and play.
Rural America is not lost.
It's being underserved,
and we can get it back.
We need leaders who believe that positive change is possible and who work hard to make it happen. This is how we can achieve success, and I want to be a part of it.
I need your help getting to DC. I need your help bringing rural voices to the table and fighting for hardworking people.
Every donation helps us get closer and closer to that goal. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
friends, thank you for your generosity, support and loyalty.
Let's get this done.
-Bob
Bob Lorinser
Candidate for US Congress
Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula
Democrat, MI01

subject: Could you do me this favor?
body:
Will you join me and be a voice for the voiceless? |
---

If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_s=73f0e585de4e4604b46e986fb89b02e8&_t=ijNYNte9JryyGthPFA_UM9L3IUwe0HseDheb346c4nu-fB4VyDllfIcGLz30UtZS6PbnHxzpXHwB9obP4eFjfilnz3mqwxuh9XnDEf3_9A4%3D)_
---
From the Desk of Marjorie Dannenfelser Hello, In our fast-paced world, it's easy to lose sight of fundamental principles, especially when it comes to complex issues. Rather than trying to understand or get involved, so often I find it's easier for people to turn a blind eye. Recently, I feel like the culture in our country has forgotten - or ignored - the most basic lessons. I've felt a growing concern about how our society perceives and values life, particularly when it comes to the development of human life. Science and research tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. We know exactly when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, can wiggle their toes, and even hear their mother's voice. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are treated as though they are not alive or even human in our society. **After speaking to the experts and talking to mothers for over 30 years as a pro-life activist, I can assure you that they are very much alive.** Our Creator has given us life as a precious gift. No person is disposable, and every life has value because we are made in His image. I believe that everyone deserves life, despite what our society, schools, or government say. I believe that together we can make a difference in our culture that has drifted off course. I believe we can bring dignity and a voice to the voiceless. I also strongly believe I'm not alone in my convictions. I believe that you believe this too. SBA Pro-Life America works everyday to bring the truth about abortion to light and shine a ray of hope into our culture. We want to give the next generation of Americans a bright future. But this future will require commitment from people like you. The first step we must all take is clearly stating what we believe and what we're willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. Will you join me and be a voice for the voiceless? Will you stand up for those that cannot do it for themselves? I've created a pro-life pledge and I'd love your support. You can join over 1 million pro-life supporters - people like you - that want to see the unborn protected, valued, and cherished. **[https://action.sbaprolife.org/stand-for-life-with-me](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=73f0e585de4e4604b46e986fb89b02e8&_e=Kn7jitGBeqORtVj4Yair0MbEAOJarUlMOxw5M-wQ3Wabzx6nft60hhFGBw8dzH3TADU-Ya9NxMkPEcocUZKPfF2jNHdGca5noCm7RV2aSUQkXpbihhYGrpDj0_3iTE73MEgEzBXg1IFwetuWU0vCQwNRSlhP7_FTxmD66QJI2xmZG8AXlCHudzUO6XTiWuBgvwQsFC7RWDdhjJitYq_iiMX-h-LDeGCi9ithysduRw3ogUNQV-ETnqEUgddrQB8v529DdkdGhO_huZaj89qdwY-QKUYGylSB8KcPyOuaB0DgDi7crPCKEwWz7uo7OS_9PUYRg8g9W22d6YfwY0w3cD50HrRQ8gQgZoB3q2FY_tS_dBaGYoGk_o3mBLgYUQpig7TRdzbPjrjyFD75qT9Fzg%3D%3D)** For Life,
Marjorie Dannenfelser
President, SBA Pro-Life America

Peter,
At the end of this email, I’m going to ask you to chip in $5 to my campaign before our end-of-quarter deadline in five days [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_foundingdonor?refcode=X_032624_EOQ_C_lesson_act&amount=5] . But first, I hope you’ll read through this email.
When I ran in 2022, a lot of people wrote us off. By November, we had been outspent 6:1. And we did lose.
But we came within one percentage point of winning.
Here’s what I learned: with your grassroots support, we can accomplish incredible things.
Our people-powered campaign focused on the issues that matter most — securing Arizona’s water future, funding our public schools, defending Social Security and Medicare, and protecting reproductive rights. Our message overcame buckets of conservative dark money in the district and resonated with voters.
Republicans know they can’t afford to lose this seat in November. They’re prepared to spend whatever it will take to protect Ciscomani — and as we learned last cycle, they’re willing to spend a lot.
Everything we raise before the end of March (just five days away!) will appear in our quarterly fundraising report.
We already have huge momentum with months to go until the election. But, showing our grassroots strength in our quarterly fundraising report is critical.
Peter, I’m asking you to chip in $5 to our campaign so we’ll have the resources to win this November. Every dollar and every donor makes a difference. Can I count on you? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_foundingdonor?refcode=X_032624_EOQ_C_lesson_act&amount=5]

Hello...

This could be the last email I send you this year, Friend.

But I have to be honest with you -- no matter how weary I am about opening up.

**As it's finally Election Year, the odds are stacked against us, and I need to know how you 'll react to this email to understand how to move forward. Your response could change everything. We missed our most recent fundraising deadline, and if we keep missing these, my campaign could be done.**

My name is Jim Banks. If you haven't heard of me, I'm an Afghanistan veteran from Indiana now serving in Congress.

I worked hard to serve my community alongside my wife, Amanda. And above all, I am a father to three amazing girls. **Now, I am also a Senate candidate in a crucial race in Indiana.**
**The outcome of this election will determine if we can take back the Senate.**
Joe Biden and his Leftist allies are pouring millions into key races across the country in an effort to wipe out GOP candidates. But I won't let them win so easily.

[**That 's why I'm reaching out today. I have decided to extend our deadline until midnight tonight, so I am humbly asking for your immediate support.**](http://links.theusapatriots.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=1872e461b97c4203af643119193aaa63&_e=VntbWxcIUT3O6lRasFBcR2aQW890gj4LkXmtnydM-_OCkG61Covh354sAgGMQlujJxaTuheOEF0XYuR-78mHNTsrH_OlG7mfLmvE5GHnqhhgQ1wcBuYy9V6BfwgOGT-ySJktKI6XQjXjuVw_-go65ksZrOaleVCcmHRKMhkINUJnDlvYo2wY-cOMT8YieS9d4dfeAfXDxw6gZq6PkkNxnbyClu4PnRrVPoxJaO9Zc1c9NQP34eLcSEohn5jfmqrb433JXl9oa-Gx3mdXbjJQLFQdmau36Sb3UirdYKHnkVKU-Ppyj4lWXF5pOo1EQGG5xd-AUbcxFbt9m4EY4tCYYg%3D%3D)
The Democrats have planted a fake Republican in my race to stop me from winning. They don't realize that I've been in this community for years, and I know that Hoosiers are fed up with the progressive narrative.

I'm not usually the type of person to ask for help, but there's no way I can make it [**if I don 't reach this critical fundraising goal.**](http://links.theusapatriots.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=1872e461b97c4203af643119193aaa63&_e=VntbWxcIUT3O6lRasFBcR2aQW890gj4LkXmtnydM-_OCkG61Covh354sAgGMQlujJxaTuheOEF0XYuR-78mHNTsrH_OlG7mfLmvE5GHnqhhgQ1wcBuYy9V6BfwgOGT-ySJktKI6XQjXjuVw_-go65ksZrOaleVCcmHRKMhkINUIFuhwO9sE8F8yBIDDZ76Y8SKkqSkNud7iAquL05km3prXMiEwsFnfkOlK_xu67ioemnqekdlkyRHSHbrXTM1HddjZm8lpGIQUdAeSKhVR3KfJSnRwc-FHPtf8HegqmZNq1buL36OopZSiv2LmiPUQ5ipu-aDQ4dFH5M1wCZxO6Yg%3D%3D)

[600x300] [] Biting spree by Biden’s dogs under investigation [] Source: The Center Square [] President Joe Biden's dogs have been on a biting spree, and now an investigation is under way. The House Education and the Workforce Committee has launched an investigation into the Occupational Safety and Health Administration raising the question: Is Biden's dog getting special treatment while White House staff fear getting bitten? [13x13x1] [] READ MORE [] Background Notes from Judicial Watch [180x150x1] [] 2023-04-07 Judicial Watch Sues Secret Service for Records on Aggression and Biting by President Biden’s Dog [] Source: Judicial Watch [] Judicial Watch filed a Freedom of Information Act lawsuit against the U.S. Department of Homeland Security for records of any incidents of aggression or biting by President Biden’s dog Commander. Acquired in December 2021, Commander, a pure-bred German Shepherd, replaced another German Shepherd, Major, which left the White House following a series of attacks on Secret Service and White House staff. [13x13x1] [] READ MORE [] [180x150x2] [] 2022-04-13 Records Reveal Multiple Attacks on Secret Service by Biden’s Dog, Agents Upset with Psaki’s Misleading Statements About an Incident [] Source: Judicial Watch [] Judicial Watch obtained 400 pages of records detailing multiple attacks and damages caused to Secret Service members by President Biden’s dog Major at the White House and Biden’s lake home in Wilmington, DE. The documents reveal that a member of the Secret Service who was attacked by the dog was displeased that White House Press Secretary Jen Psaki misled the press about the incident. [13x13x1] [] READ MORE [] [180x150x3] [] 2024-02-28 Records Reveal at Least 23 Biting Incidents by Biden’s Dog Commander [] Source: Judicial Watch [] Judicial Watch received 269 pages of records from the Secret Service related to incidents of aggression by President Biden’s dog Commander, including at least 23 biting incidents. Mike

body:
Our country desperately needs Kansas common sense right now | | |
---
| |
---
| Dear Kansan,

America is in desperate need of some Kansas common sense right now. That is why I filed for reelection, so I can continue to take the fight to Washington.

President Biden and his liberal allies are running our country into the ground with big government spending, big government overreach, and a total failure to secure our southern border. **_Under the Biden Administration, Americans have suffered:_** \- The worst border crisis in American history
\- $34 trillion in national debt
\- The highest inflation in 40 years
\- The violation of our Constitutional rights **_Now is the time to act. We need to save our country by restoring:_** ✓ Freedom
✓ Security
✓ Prosperity

The Big First is the pilot light of America because the values that make America great are still alive and well in our hometowns – faith, family, freedom, hard work, loving your neighbor, and personal responsibility. I live by these conservative Kansas values, and advocate for them in Congress every day. I do not serve in Congress to be a caretaker in the slow demise of America. I serve to work and fight to make our country stronger.

_For too long, the federal government has been telling Americans to sit down, be quiet, submit, and be grateful that things aren’t worse. That’s not my vision of this country, and I don’t serve in Congress to be passive. _

My message is this: stand up, make your voice heard, exercise your freedoms, and let’s work together to make America stronger. Let’s fire Biden, restore the American dream, and, together, restore real leadership to our country.

Please make your voice heard and support conservative Kansas values by joining in the fight to save America. **_Your contribution before the end of the month, whether it’s $25 or $13,200 (the max for a married couple), will help keep our country going in the right direction_.**
**_You can ([Click Here](https://traceymann.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60a16ea89a176679a5f31366c&id=219e8e19da&e=a9d1410029)) or visit my website at [www.traceymann.com](https://traceymann.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60a16ea89a176679a5f31366c&id=ce60906ee7&e=a9d1410029) to learn more or contribute online_.**
I believe with hard work and prayer our brightest days are yet to come! Thank you for your support – I could not do this without your help.

In the Fight,
Tracey Mann

P.S. I stand for Kansas, and I always will. I promise that I will do everything within my power to ensure that our kids have a bright future. Please donate today ([Click Here](https://traceymann.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60a16ea89a176679a5f31366c&id=f645148670&e=a9d1410029)) and help take our country back.

I serve to work and fight to make our country stronger. For too long, the federal government has been telling Americans to sit down, be quiet, submit, and be grateful that things aren’t worse. That’s not my vision of this country, and I don’t serve in Congress to be passive. My message is this: stand up, make your voice heard, exercise your freedoms, and let’s work together to make America stronger. Let’s fire Biden, restore the American dream, and, together, restore real leadership to our country. Please make your voice heard and support conservative Kansas values by joining in the fight to save America. # [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38798%2E3422442%2EjIZKJk)
Katie Porter here.
Derek, in early January my term in Congress will come to an end, and _I won’t sugarcoat it: I want to leave Congress knowing that our fight for a better future will continue on thanks to good Members like Rep. Susan Wild._
Susan is one of my closest friends in Congress. She’s there for the right reasons, she’s getting things done, and she’s not afraid to stand up to special interests.
But Susan represents a highly-competitive Pennsylvania district, and we’re at real risk of losing her. **If we don’t hold this seat, Democrats stand almost no chance at taking that Speaker’s gavel back from Mike Johnson.**
**[Is there anything you can give right now that will be split between Susan Wild’s campaign and my organization, Truth to Power?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240326-wild?refcode=em20240326-38798&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38798_3422442_jIZKJk&akid=38798%2E3422442%2EjIZKJk)**

We want to hear what you think → | Do you support access to medication abortion (mifepristone)? | | ---|--- Peter, Last year, a Trump-appointed federal judge in Texas ordered the FDA to reverse its approval of mifepristone, a safe and essential abortion medication. Wade and destroyed the right to choose nationwide. Make no mistake, Peter, this is exactly what Republicans were hoping would happen when they packed the Supreme Court with dangerous anti-choice justices. Despite overwhelming research affirming mifepristone's safety, millions of Americans' access to reproductive care now lies in the hands of an unelected court with no medical expertise. **We're running a nationwide poll to gauge what this community thinks about the Supreme Court and this landmark case — and we want to hear from you, Peter.
