Missouri’s former Senior Senator Roy Blunt secured more than $350 million for our state in his final year in the U.S. Senate. But now, recent reporting from the Kansas City Star found that Missouri lost out on hundreds of millions of dollars under the leadership of Missouri’s current Senior Senator, Josh Hawley. These funds typically cover critical investments — like improvements at state universities, upgrades for local police departments, and aid for community groups. But instead of doing his job and fighting for that money to come home to Missouri, Josh Hawley has only thought about himself. After he violated Missouri open records laws, Missouri taxpayers were on the hook for more than $250,000 — which Hawley refuses to pay back: On top of that, he’s been busy making money on the side with book sales — like his creepy “Manhood” book — and raking in hundreds of thousands of dollars more than his Congressional salary. #### **By joining this movement, you're standing up for a democracy that cherishes TRUTH, JUSTICE, & LOVE.**

_**Did you know?** _ _Every state requires independent candidates to meet unique requirements to be allowed alongside the corporate duopoly party candidates on the state election ballot. As a result, Dr. West will implement a variety of strategies to secure ballot access in all 50 states.___
---

## Why Dr. West?
**_Dr. West enters the 2024 Presidential contest_** _at a time in which he describes a national crisis of moral bankruptcy and spiritual obscenity driven by a derelict duopoly of both major parties that equally places profits over people and the planet._ He views it as his duty to deliver policy prescriptions incorporated by and for the people, instead of political parties beholden to corporations and special interest groups who feel no solidarity with poor and working-class people of all races, gender identities, and age groups.****
---
### **[View Brother West's campaign policy pillars here](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/platform?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ballot_access_email_2_staffing&n=5).**
---
## 5 Steps to take NOW to ensure ballot access for Dr. West in your state:
1. **Find your state on the[Ballot Access Map at CornelWest2024.com](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/petitioning_launch?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ballot_access_email_2_staffing&n=6)** to learn which strategy is underway in your state and discover the specific ways you can help.

2. **Register to Vote Now** : If you have not already registered, register to vote in your state. When registering to vote, register as a member with the party aligned with the campaign in your state, if applicable.

3. **Get Your Lawn Sign, Swag, and Flyers:[Visit the Cornel West for President merch store](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/r?u=sxSABYF2yFKLmjlawhS_a10tpmpna_SE_wWQJfDfMOXvAff9UGAH6wB-xTazEj1M&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ballot_access_email_2_staffing&n=7) **to make sure your friends, family, and neighbors know they have more positive options that put people first. Show you have the courage to envision a future of truth, justice, and love for our children.

---

This weekend, President Biden signed a bill into law that most members of Congress voted for, which sent billions of American tax dollars to the Pentagon, ICE, and Israel’s military.
This just-passed legislation also ended U.S. funding for the UN agency known as UNRWA, which is the primary provider and distributor of aid within Gaza—including food, water, healthcare, and emergency shelter.

I voted no on the bill, which also prohibits funding for UN investigations into the Israeli government’s human rights violations.

With aid trucks just miles away, more than 1 million people in Gaza are facing imminent famine. Israel’s apartheid government controls all of Gaza’s entrances and exits and has cut off nearly all necessities from entering Gaza, such as food, water, baby formula, and key medical supplies. Amid this forced starvation, Congress and the White House just cut funding for at least a year for UNRWA, the UN agency that’s the main provider and distributor of essential aid in Gaza. Passed by Congress and signed into law by President Biden, this legislation also continues sending billions of our tax dollars to Israel’s military without conditions, while it commits genocide. | Yesterday, in a historic vote, the United Nations voted 14-0 in favor of a temporary ceasefire resolution. While this is not nearly enough—we demand a permanent ceasefire now—it shows that our pressure on the U.S. government is working. Instead of blocking the vote like it has multiple times, the United States abstained. Let’s continue to keep the pressure on President Biden to end the genocide and allow critical humanitarian aid into Gaza now. Thank you. This just-passed legislation also ended U.S. funding for the UN agency known as UNRWA, which is the primary provider and distributor of aid within Gaza—including food, water, healthcare, and emergency shelter. More than 1 million people in Gaza are facing imminent famine. Children, who are especially vulnerable, have begun starving to death. And our government is making it worse, blocking starving Palestinians from receiving needed assistance. I voted no on the bill, which also prohibits funding for UN investigations into the Israeli government’s human rights violations. Human rights experts agree that Israel’s government is violating international humanitarian law in numerous ways, including by using starvation as a weapon of war—intentionally targeting Gaza’s food and water infrastructure, bombing aid centers, blocking aid trucks carrying key supplies and baby formula, and massacring starving Palestinians seeking food. Because of these horrors, the United Nations has been pushing for a ceasefire. The U.S. has blocked ceasefire votes in the UN Security Council, until today. Today the United Nations voted 14-0 in favor of a temporary ceasefire through the remainder of Ramadan. The U.S. abstained from the vote, allowing the vote to proceed. While we need a lasting, permanent ceasefire, this is an important first step that shows that our pressure on President Biden is working. Now’s the time to keep pushing! Nearly everyone in Gaza has had to move multiple times in the past five months, and most have sought shelter in UNRWA facilities. As the best-equipped group to provide life-saving humanitarian aid on a massive scale in Gaza, UNRWA needs funding now more than ever. Thank you for taking action to affirm our shared humanity. name: Dovid Efune
subject: Our arms are open to all Americans
body:
Americans are waking up, and the movement to save American journalism is gathering speed.
Join the Sun and restore American journalism.

| | | [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=11c7d46cb6e047b2b42ce6248f0769a4&_e=jm2gNU5RONctWwQUhi4F9FSVKYGjfYa3GnOOGK154OZFvoBC05rujFe79-mmTky9ty3w531hBtHqPFXmw819s7ws2Bxyl5hduhxiB7p3eEU7keApxDNQB4P-F--9gWHLE35xgrdebqd-WEnQNR3xn9UEdFpz2UE19zKFRcOKfZqnAWC0MvJo_MNGOw7NhIbUlof26tji4GvJNxG8FvD46bgZCSBpXkbzbxuEt-ECCuik7RpBWMgCoZEWvLeM-W9bq-wf2UpeGO8qjinL6ZE4jOg3YTEX8LVYzmRols3__zlavtRFOB_gp9IBPeG9I5dJNnnJc_lSaxEGE-MGOBZiNG3W_FZ2zU9N1QgYKdH5mA3amRdpS601bpZTMD33970qxZtRWqG47zdjfNLWWXBy6g%3D%3D)
---
|
---
| | _Dear Peter,_ _It's no secret that the mainstream press is failing the American people dismally. And yet, I'm optimistic about the future. Americans are waking up, and the movement to save American journalism is gathering speed._ _It is the honor of my life to help lead the charge by returning the famed New York Sun to the center of the national conversation. Below is a note I just shared with my fellow citizens on the recent anniversary of our return to publication. I hope you'll take a moment to read it and consider joining our fast growing movement._ _We need you. We need every patriot to stand with us._ *** As we mark this year the second anniversary of The New York Sun's return to national daily publishing, reports on our industry are dire. Layoffs are everywhere. Last month, Los Angeles Times fired 20 percent of its newsroom. The Wall Street Journal reduced the staff of its Washington bureau. NBC News, ABC News, Time magazine, Sports Illustrated, National Geographic, Insider, NPR, Vox, Conde Nast, and CBC all announced layoffs. Buzzfeed News, Pitchfork, and the Messenger shuttered their doors completely. A Northwestern University study released in November finds that nationally, newspapers are closing down at a rate of 2.5 a week, mostly weekly publications issued locally. Questions swirl about the future of the industry. One headline in the Atlantic asks, "Is American Journalism Headed Toward an Extinction-Level Event?" Predictions are dire. Uncertainty is rampant. The mood, in general, is grim.
---
| | [JOIN THE SUN](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=11c7d46cb6e047b2b42ce6248f0769a4&_e=jm2gNU5RONctWwQUhi4F9FSVKYGjfYa3GnOOGK154OZFvoBC05rujFe79-mmTky9ty3w531hBtHqPFXmw819s7ws2Bxyl5hduhxiB7p3eEU7keApxDNQB4P-F--9gWHLE35xgrdebqd-WEnQNR3xn9UEdFpz2UE19zKFRcOKfZqnAWC0MvJo_MNGOw7NhIbUlof26tji4GvJNxG8FvD46bgZCSBpXkbzbxuEt-ECCujhWhFMqTFZFcuD8M3i72Xc0faPa3k-C1_GACklpbAxUgF4Pm5I09qXvyboEvUXgWrAarjW_wrvqYda2vhT1-x_bUkMKoi0KxeEsBEm_FRg-loOz-0RhWnSnZuMWv32TldvUS8OXeYcMAHbhBRCoCCZlW_L4se8WRz3nbsPThwbkg%3D%3D)
---
| | It would be a mistake, though, to ignore the fact that human nature is a constant. The uniform desire - nay, need - to be informed has obtained since the birth of civilization. “The newspaper is an article of primary necessity," the Sun's pioneering 19th century editor, Charles Dana, once said. "You must have your breakfast, but you must have your newspaper too." Indeed, news consumption on the whole remains high. It seems, then, that what appears as a contraction is in fact a form of correction. The market is offering a vigorous reminder of its most enduring truth, that a newspaper's primary customer is its reader. It's a principle that in many quarters has faded over time, more so amid the industry upheaval that has in recent decades accompanied the digital revolution. This and other factors have led to a realignment of priorities at many of our country's most storied publishers. They have come to serve other masters. First among them are advertisers. The temptation is understandable. They've long paid the newsman's bills. The Sun, we must confess, played a role in introducing this model. As the first penny daily, it sold for a fraction of the price of competitor papers. It pioneered front-page advertising to offset the lower subscription price. Later, Charles Dana was described as being "barely tolerant" of advertisers and dreamed of a newspaper that was wholly supported by readers.Other papers have come to prioritize the politics, leading to a deliberate effort to downplay important stories of public interest. There have been newspapers acquired as status symbols by billionaires and deployed as ideological playthings. Others have been designed or repurposed as government organs. The Telegraph in Britain, a fine newspaper, is now at risk of being swallowed up by the United Arab Emirates. There are even calls for government funding of newspapers and journalism en masse, a terrible idea, and fully incompatible with the democratic vision of a free press. At the Sun, we hold the view that the opportunity remains greater than ever for any newspaper that is compiled with a view to serve the reader above all. In the words of Charles Dana, a newspaper "must correspond to the wants of the people. It must furnish that sort of information which the people demand, or else it can never be successful." Our aim is for every interaction with the Sun to inform, educate, inspire, and uplift our readers. To do battle on their behalf to protect the "social freedom" that our republic is in danger of entirely losing. So that "every intellectual plant grows vigorously and bears its fruit without hindrance from any quarter." We’ve been encouraged by the public reception so far. I'm pleased to report that our readership has grown by more than 300 percent over the past year. Paying memberships, sustaining the Sun's journalism, have grown by 500 percent. We've added new, exciting talent to our newsroom. Daily we hear from young people who are hopeful about making a career of journalism. We're not guided by the subjective and parochial analysis of what might be decreed "fit to print." We're a paper that for nearly 200 years has borne the promise to "shine for all." That means relentlessly seeking the benefit and welfare of our readers and all of the public which we serve. Nothing less will do for the Sun. So may I take this occasion to express, on behalf of my colleagues as well as myself, my sincerest thanks to each of you who have joined us over the past year. And to declare that our arms are held open to all Americans who have yet to make the Sun their home.
---

---
Yours sincerely,
---

We want to express our heartfelt gratitude for your early support in our campaign to send Gloria Johnson to Congress as our next United States Senator from Tennessee! Join us for our monthly Tennessee Women Rising Zoom meeting where you can connect with Gloria, her dedicated campaign staff, and fellow supporters. Share your ideas, ask questions, and be part of the conversation shaping our future. Here's how you can get involved right now: Register for the event on April 5th, 2024 - 11:30AM CST / 12:30pm EST using the link . Spread the word! Thank you for your unwavering support and dedication to democracy. With gratitude, TN Women Rising - for Gloria Johnson P.S. To show off your pride in Gloria's campaign, ! name: Sen. Tim Kaine
subject: Our rights, freedoms, and values are on the ballot this year
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Democratic National Committee **[www
body:
This month will set the tone for the rest of the year. | |
---
Hi Derek, it's Tim Kaine, U.S. Senator from Virginia. I wanted to reach out to you personally because March 31 marks the end of the first quarter of 2024, and what we can get done this month will set the tone for the rest of this critical election year. We have a major election season ahead of us. Local offices, Senate seats like mine, and the Oval Office are all on the ballot. There is so much at stake -- most importantly, our basic rights, freedoms, and values. [**With MAGA Republicans like Donald Trump eager to flip the Senate and win the presidency, I have to ask: Will you split a $10 donation between the DNC and my campaign? freedomva.org [freedomva.org]
Friends-
Last week we went on our with the Virginians for Affordable Medicine Coalition to call on Governor Youngkin to sign the proposed Prescription Drug Affordability Board legislation.
We were lucky to be joined by the chief patron of the Senate PDAB bill Sen. Creigh Deeds as well as local legislators Del. Sam Rasoul and Del. Amy Laufer on our stops. Our partners at AARP Virginia as well as members of the community who have felt the impact of rising prescription costs spoke as well.
Our first stop was in Roanoke and we thank the Local Office on Aging for their hospitality:
image of ... [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMMP/1/85567/images/IMG_3095.jpeg]
WSLS: Mobile billboard advocating for affordable medications travels through Roanoke [https://www.wsls.com/news/local/2024/03/20/mobile-billboard-advocating-for-affordable-medications-travels-through-roanoke/]
The Roanoke Times: Roanoke patients seek affordable prescription prices [https://roanoke.com/news/state-regional/government-politics/prescription-drug-affordability-board-roanoke-event-politics-government-cost-of-living-prices/article_cf9e17b8-e6e5-11ee-99fe-4b7ae57e3e12.html]
WDBJ7: Supporters of Prescription Drug Affordability Board proposal urge Gov. Youngkin to sign legislation [https://www.wdbj7.com/2024/03/20/supporters-prescription-drug-affordability-board-proposal-urge-gov-youngkin-sign-legislation/?outputType=amp]
Our second stop was in Charlottesville and we thank Trinity Episcopal Church for their hospitality:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMMP/1/85567/images/IMG_3114.jpeg]
Augusta Free Press: Charlottesville: Virginians urge Governor Youngkin to sign bill in support of drug affordability board [https://augustafreepress.com/news/charlottesville-virginians-urge-governor-youngkin-to-sign-bill-in-support-of-drug-affordability-board/]
29 News: Group urging Governor Youngkin to sign bipartisan bill to lower medicine costs [https://www.29news.com/2024/03/21/group-urging-governor-youngkin-sign-bipartisan-bill-lower-medicine-costs/]
We’re grateful for all of the support we have seen for the Prescription Drug Affordability Board these past months. Governor Youngkin has until April 8th to sign this legislation and bring down the cost of living for all Virginians by bringing down the cost of medicine!
Let’s establish a Prescription Drug Affordability Board in Virginia!
Natalie Jones

Campaigns cost money. _A lot of money._ I wish they didn’t, but this is what we’re working with. And if we want to continue getting stuff done in the Senate, then I need to win this election. Plain and simple.

The GOP is already hammering me with vicious attacks. They’re trying to turn me into someone I’m not—**because they can’t beat who I am.**

That’s where you come in. Your donation helps us respond to dishonest attacks, fund our TV ads, and invest in voter outreach efforts. It makes a real difference in this race. **So if you can,** [**will you split a donation before the end-of-quarter FEC deadline between my campaign and Fight for Reform (to help them elect pro-democracy state and local Dems)? I’m going head-to-head with Adam Schiff in November.Democrat policies have brought America to its knees.There’s fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. Since our founding in 2017, the NDRC and our affiliates have achieved the fairest maps in 40 years, according to _The New York Times_. And we’re nowhere near done. That’s the plan in broad strokes, but the truth is none of this work is in the distant future. I don’t have to tell you that the area we call home has been suffering since 2020, when my opponent Mike Schmidt was elected Multnomah County District Attorney. _**Crime is up, people feel unsafe, criminals remain on our streets, and we all bear the brunt.**_ **It's time for a change.**
**I am committed to restoring safety, accountability, and justice in Multnomah County.**_**But I need your help to get there.** _Massive out-of-state special interest groups helped elect my opponent last time around and we assume they will come in again. We need you.

| [Join the Fight Here](https://voteforvasquez.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2859120a283c12ca5aac18412&id=4dff94e179&e=ffb5e20bef)
---
Your support will make a significant impact. As your next District Attorney, I will focus on:
* **Swift Prosecution** : I'll implement reforms to streamline the prosecutorial process, ensuring justice is served promptly.

* **Empowering Victims** : victims far too often remain unheard under Schmidt’s “leadership”. That will end with me as your next DA.

* **Neighborhood Safety** : Together, we'll build strong ties between law enforcement and the community, fostering trust and understanding.

* **Restore Trust** : together we will show once again that the District Attorney's office works for the people of Multnomah County, not as some experiment funded by out-of-state dark money groups.

_**Will you join me in creating a safer and more secure future for our county?**_ Your donation, no matter the size, matters.

Best,Nathan VasquezCandidate for Multnomah County District Attorney

body:
“Dad, when are you getting home?”

| | |
---
It sucks, Friend. It really does. I’ve been on the road for months, crisscrossing the state. All the while, my kids are texting me, asking me when I’ll be home. But the truth is this: I’m not running for office for the status. I’d prefer to lead a private life, raise my kids, and go out on a date with my wife every once in a while. I’m not running for office for the money. I’m a successful small businessman and would be better off financially if I didn’t run for anything. And I’m not running for office because it’s fun or easy. Running for office is one of the hardest things I’ve ever had to do – since I launched my campaign I’ve had to watch my kids grow up a lot without me. But our country needs leaders who know what it means to sacrifice. And I’m running for Senate to fill that void. **_[_Can I count on your support?_](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkT2L5SAUhn-N6Qx6TExSpFgIA1vMNlNsKUZN7mHjB2q4zL9fvMyUC9vJUZ7zvK-_39W7xgvD-Ut7t2IpKhdlvNpzfAaKlZbb_CkKGAjKBAWpoLPrCHw-5s6tfOJ8WEY5s-6xLuMw6UPYne_iYMsx8XGRAg4H8zTIZexwBQYDEyCBwzBOvTu4NdbaYdq1kSMnA7uT1dX1GApaV0yMKcULK5rSx3x21_qoNRUifhB4I_BWnLmz658YsrO9ib7NtKcv_9fZZDzQOOo_TbxDzZ_lEXOlSTeAeLurVyXe2TgitpRjSc5UDCcB2a68s3h7IraHps5rvL7mRvuk8QxEbF-ZRuUY4zDOtOzqX2tVW_sCVEPE9vPjA-h3J9_kGKoLtdm0t7kFzE1IbDXfjoDUvhGJ2Lq82vTE68IiJzKwswm2Err6f1_5NwAA___gfqgg)_ ** Joe Biden, Chuck Schumer, and the radical left have lost their minds. They’re putting illegal immigrants over veterans. They’re putting criminals over law abiding citizens. They’re injecting woke ideology into every facet of our military. When people ask me why I’m running my genuine response is: “I didn’t have a choice. It’s my lifelong, sacred duty to defend this country.” Chuck Schumer has a $37+ million dollar war chest ready to defeat me and end my campaign. I’m on a mission to bring a new generation of Conservative leadership to the U.S. Senate – and put an END to the limp-wristed insanity of the Biden/Schumer regime. But without your support, all the blood, sweat, and tears my family and I have poured into this campaign could go to waste. _**[_**Please, if you could, chip in a donation to my campaign today?**_](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkT2L5SAUhn-N6Qx6TExSpFgIA1vMNlNsKUZN7mHjB2q4zL9fvMyUC9vJUZ7zvK-_39W7xgvD-Ut7t2IpKhdlvNpzfAaKlZbb_CkKGAjKBAWpoLPrCHw-5s6tfOJ8WEY5s-6xLuMw6UPYne_iYMsx8XGRAg4H8zTIZexwBQYDEyCBwzBOvTu4NdbaYdq1kSMnA7uT1dX1GApaV0yMKcULK5rSx3x21_qoNRUifhB4I_BWnLmz658YsrO9ib7NtKcv_9fZZDzQOOo_TbxDzZ_lEXOlSTeAeLurVyXe2TgitpRjSc5UDCcB2a68s3h7IraHps5rvL7mRvuk8QxEbF-ZRuUY4zDOtOzqX2tVW_sCVEPE9vPjA-h3J9_kGKoLtdm0t7kFzE1IbDXfjoDUvhGJ2Lq82vTE68IiJzKwswm2Err6f1_5NwAA___gfqgg)**_ The one bright spot is that I get to talk to God-fearing American patriots every day. clean_body: “Dad, when are you getting home?” | | | It sucks, Friend. It really does. I’ve been on the road for months, crisscrossing the state. All the while, my kids are texting me, asking me when I’ll be home. But the truth is this: I’m not running for office for the status. I’d prefer to lead a private life, raise my kids, and go out on a date with my wife every once in a while. I’m not running for office for the money. I’m a successful small businessman and would be better off financially if I didn’t run for anything. And I’m not running for office because it’s fun or easy. Running for office is one of the hardest things I’ve ever had to do – since I launched my campaign I’ve had to watch my kids grow up a lot without me. But our country needs leaders who know what it means to sacrifice. And I’m running for Senate to fill that void. Joe Biden, Chuck Schumer, and the radical left have lost their minds. They’re putting illegal immigrants over veterans. They’re putting criminals over law abiding citizens. They’re injecting woke ideology into every facet of our military. When people ask me why I’m running my genuine response is: “I didn’t have a choice. It’s my lifelong, sacred duty to defend this country.” Chuck Schumer has a $37+ million dollar war chest ready to defeat me and end my campaign. I’m on a mission to bring a new generation of Conservative leadership to the U.S. Senate – and put an END to the limp-wristed insanity of the Biden/Schumer regime. But without your support, all the blood, sweat, and tears my family and I have poured into this campaign could go to waste. The one bright spot is that I get to talk to God-fearing American patriots every day. Thank you so much for all you do for our great country. Duty First, CPT Sam Brown | | Sam Brown is a retired member of the U.S. Army. subject: Young American State Trooper killed by an Illegal.

body:
Dear Patriot,
_As a retired Green Beret and Gold Star husband, I know only too well the pain of losing a loved one for no good reason._
Today, I want to tell you about Washington State Patrol Trooper Christopher Gadd.
Gadd was born in Pasco, Washington on September 28, 1996. He graduated from Kentlake High School in 2015, then went to Green River College and Tacoma Community College, earning his EMT certification.
Gadd then began working as a cadet with the Washington State Police in 2021, transferring in 2022 to train to become part of the 116th Trooper Basic Training class. Being a trooper was part of his blood, as his father is a WSP trooper, and his sister is also a trooper in Texas. Gadd quickly rose to the top of his class and graduated in November 2022, earning a top academic award recognizing cadets who attain the highest GPA over 30 exams and quizzes.
He was a husband and a father of a two-year-old. His life was barely beginning.
**And on March 2 of this year, Gadd was killed at the age of 27 on the side of I-5 in Marysville just before 3 a.m. when an illegal immigrant allegedly crashed into his patrol vehicle.**
_According to court documents, this illegal, Raul Benitez-Santana, smoked "a bowl of Marijuana" earlier that night and had a glass of beer._
Benitez-Santana is a citizen of Mexico and illegally entered the U.S. at an unknown time, but his criminal history in the U.S. dates back to **2013** when he was convicted of driving with a suspended license.
**_That 's right - this illegal was in America for over ELEVEN YEARS without the consequence of deportation while he continued to rack up a criminal history! _**
This is because Washington State has sanctuary status, thus protecting an illegal alien who went on to kill upstanding citizens of society like Trooper Gadd.
**This is unconscionable, and something has to be done. Protecting Washington residents from violent crimes perpetrated by illegals is one of the things I feel called to do, and I will keep working to push back on our sanctuary status.**
Illegals need to be deported, not allowed to stay in our state and harm us!
**_I have a big task ahead of me this year, and the first quarter is almost over! I need to reach my fundraising goal of $15,000 before March 31 so I can continue strong through the second quarter. Will you support me in achieving this short-term goal so we can together march toward our long-term vision of a Washington free from the violent crimes brought to us by illegal aliens? Whether it be $5, $15, $150, $1,500, or even more, every dollar will help us sweep Washington 's Third District red. Please donate at _****_[https://JoeKentforCongress.com/](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/GbyiPr3daIt9C763763u0ktwGg/XGOpqTfm9c4OUOujs0ZVmQ)_**
Thank you for your commitment to preserving our conservative values and helping Make America Great Again. Your trust that I can do the job is what keeps me going.
Humbly yours,
Joe Kent
Republican Candidate for Congress (WA-03)
Former Special Forces Operator
America First Conservative

Peter,
Whether Ruben Gallego wins or loses is going to depend on whether we raise the resources we need or not.
A big part of those resources are the money we need to run a successful campaign — and our donors have put us in a strong position.
But another resource is people — the ones we’ll depend on to call, text, knock doors, persuade people, and turn out the voters we need to win.
We’ve had a real surge of support since Kyrsten Sinema dropped out, and that’s great. But in time, we’re going to start calling upon our top supporters to play a bigger role.
So, if you’re with Ruben, if you care about this race, and if you’re ready to help hold the Senate:

| | Today, the Supreme Court heard oral arguments in a case brought to them by far-right anti-abortion activists hoping to rip away access to the abortion medication, mifepristone. Mifepristone accounts for 70% of all abortions nationwide. **If the Court sides with these right-wing extremists, their ruling will restrict access to mifepristone — even in states where abortion is still legal, like Oregon.** In 1990, I chaired the first-ever Congressional hearing on mifepristone, and started leading the charge to help get this medication onto the market. Over 30 years later, I can't believe I still have to say what I said back then: this should be about science over politics, plain and simple. Far-right extremists are basing their case on false claims. In fact, this case _never_ should have made it before the Supreme Court. The extremists propelling this case forward relied on a dangerous practice known as "judge shopping," when activist plaintiffs guarantee their case will be heard by judges they know will rule in their favor. In this case, the far-right chose a judge in Texas – hand-picked by Donald Trump – to hand them the ruling they were hoping for. **This case has nothing to do with science and everything to do with Republicans' perverse obsession with controlling women's bodies.** Just like I've been doing for the last 30 years, I'm going to keep fighting with everything I've got to reject Republican attempts to rip away our fundamental freedoms. But this also underscores just how critical it is to protect our razor-thin majority in the Senate so we can continue to confirm judges nationwide who will stand on the side of the law, not politics. clean_body: | | | | Today, the Supreme Court heard oral arguments in a case brought to them by far-right anti-abortion activists hoping to rip away access to the abortion medication, mifepristone. Mifepristone accounts for 70% of all abortions nationwide. If the Court sides with these right-wing extremists, their ruling will restrict access to mifepristone — even in states where abortion is still legal, like Oregon. In 1990, I chaired the first-ever Congressional hearing on mifepristone, and started leading the charge to help get this medication onto the market. Over 30 years later, I can't believe I still have to say what I said back then: this should be about science over politics, plain and simple. Far-right extremists are basing their case on false claims. In fact, this case never should have made it before the Supreme Court. The extremists propelling this case forward relied on a dangerous practice known as "judge shopping," when activist plaintiffs guarantee their case will be heard by judges they know will rule in their favor. In this case, the far-right chose a judge in Texas – hand-picked by Donald Trump – to hand them the ruling they were hoping for. This case has nothing to do with science and everything to do with Republicans' perverse obsession with controlling women's bodies. Just like I've been doing for the last 30 years, I'm going to keep fighting with everything I've got to reject Republican attempts to rip away our fundamental freedoms. But this also underscores just how critical it is to protect our razor-thin majority in the Senate so we can continue to confirm judges nationwide who will stand on the side of the law, not politics. Between now and November, I'm going to be working as hard as I can to protect and expand our majority in the Senate, and I hope you'll stand with me. clean_body: | | | Peter, This Sunday is the final End of Quarter deadline before Rep. Jamaal Bowman’s primary against AIPAC’s top recruit. This election will determine whether the people of NY-16 are represented by a champion who fights for working people — or the choice of Trump-supporting Republican megadonors who want to stop our progress and drag us all backwards. AIPAC isn’t slowing down their efforts to unseat our Congressional champions and put MAGA Republicans back in full power in Washington, D.C. So we can’t slow down either. For years, AIPAC has supported extremist MAGA Republicans, including over 100 who tried to overturn the 2020 election. Now they are aiming their sights directly at Black and brown progressives in Congress who have called for a ceasefire, the safe return of hostages taken by Hamas, and an end to Netanyahu’s siege of Gaza civilians — and Jamaal Bowman is #1 on their target list. From affordable housing, to high-quality public education, to youth programs, Jamaal has worked tirelessly to make sure that the communities in his district have what we need to thrive. And as one of the first members of Congress to call for a ceasefire in Gaza, we know we can count on him to stand for what’s right. With AIPAC making Jamaal one of their top targets this cycle — and with the final quarterly deadline before the primary coming up in just a few days — now is the time to show him we have his back and build up the resources we need to fight back. | Since 1977, the iconic Francis Scott Key Bridge has connected residents and visitors, supported business and commerce, and brought people together throughout the Baltimore region.

Today, we woke up to the devastating news that the Francis Scott Key Bridge collapsed early this morning.

Our first and most important priority is–and will continue to be– _**search, rescue, and recovery.**_ I am also working with state and federal partners to remain updated on what’s happening on the ground and make sure we are doing all we can to support everyone impacted.

This is a time to come together as a community and take care of one another. I want to thank our selfless first responders for their courage and strength during this horrific tragedy and for their commitment to our community.

Our hearts are with the victims of this tragedy and their loved ones. Please pray for those impacted.

In service,

Johnny O

body:
[View in Web Browser](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8kD1PwzAQhn_NZWtkn-M4HjxAqzBUsIHE6M_WlU1SJ23ov0cNheGW-3ju0avzmGK4KRDPgHiMbgJEYE-AeP5ccrmc8v5lo18P3ebcvmV-n-IWEOfb6P9XH5TaZx3TvSt2lVMsONJUXlFBaSMJb7rqqJhjHGlnREDToqfGGsa9kF6ilCaEKiok2BCGLSJB2tW2C1RK7UzbCWHQQkPWP7XOvkSr6TQvupRhyLUdcpXUcZ7HaRXrAfulDPXXxSZ_mX7P7JAB-4cyYH-91_Wb7997ftoC69cU2K794H5LdjpXRblxiSnFqRXQkMMf5icAAP__lyVgLw)

You've been told over and over in the media that foods like oatmeal and quinoa are good for you, and you should eat lots of them. But what most people don't realize is that these two particular foods contain compounds that can actually harm your health and your digestion in many ways...

And as your favorite Nutritionist, I'll explain why in this quick email, so you can avoid further harming your health and digestion with these so-called "healthy" foods...
**
1\. Oatmeal and Oat Milk**

While oatmeal is touted as a healthy carb and a source of fiber, unfortunately there are more cons than pros with this food...

The first problem with oats is that they are loaded with a compound called phytic acid (phytates) that significantly lowers your absorption of certain minerals and vitamins, such as calcium, magnesium, and zinc.

So whenever you eat oats, the phytic acid causes you to absorb less of these vitally important minerals which could cause health problems if you eat oats too frequently, since most people already don't get enough minerals like magnesium and zinc.

The second problem with oats is that they contain one of the highest residue concentrations of the **toxic herbicide glyphosate, which can damage your gut, and have been linked to other health problems like cancer** , hormone issues, and more.

The next major problem with oats is that they are a significant source of **mycotoxins** in the diet, which are mold based toxins that can cause an array of gut problems, hormone problems and more.

Lastly, oats can also contain high levels of the **toxic heavy metal** Cadmium, which is linked to health problems as this toxic heavy metal accumulates in your body.

**2\. Quinoa**

Quinoa is another food that is pitched as a health food or a "superfood". Unfortunately, this is another example of a food that has more downsides than good sides.

First off, quinoa is high in compounds called saponins, that have been shown in some studies to **cause gut damage and contribute to "leaky gut".**

Another problematic compound in quinoa are lectins, which are a type of antinutrient that can **damage the cells of your intestines** , and contribute to several gut disorders and immune system problems.

Many friends and colleagues of mine have reported feeling abdominal pain after eating quinoa, bloating, and loose stools or diarrhea, as well as triggering of autoimmune conditions such as skin conditions.

Now let's take a look at a fun little quiz below and a few more foods...

**Broccoli vs Kale vs Green Beans... (the #1 WORST veggie for your gut & energy)**
According to the best-selling author and world-renowned heart surgeon, Dr. Steven Gundry, there's one veggie people over 40 should never eat.

This veggie can **damage your gut and disrupt your hormones...** It contains a toxin that damages the lining of your intestines, causes bloating, embarrassing gas, and a bulging belly.

Do you know the veggie I'm talking about? Make sure you do by clicking the one below you think it is, and get the answer from Dr. Gundry himself on the next page:

[>> Green Beans

>> Broccoli

clean_body: You've been told over and over in the media that foods like oatmeal and quinoa are good for you, and you should eat lots of them. But what most people don't realize is that these two particular foods contain compounds that can actually harm your health and your digestion in many ways... And as your favorite Nutritionist, I'll explain why in this quick email, so you can avoid further harming your health and digestion with these so-called "healthy" foods... 1\. Oatmeal and Oat Milk While oatmeal is touted as a healthy carb and a source of fiber, unfortunately there are more cons than pros with this food... The first problem with oats is that they are loaded with a compound called phytic acid (phytates) that significantly lowers your absorption of certain minerals and vitamins, such as calcium, magnesium, and zinc. So whenever you eat oats, the phytic acid causes you to absorb less of these vitally important minerals which could cause health problems if you eat oats too frequently, since most people already don't get enough minerals like magnesium and zinc. The second problem with oats is that they contain one of the highest residue concentrations of the toxic herbicide glyphosate, which can damage your gut, and have been linked to other health problems like cancer , hormone issues, and more. The next major problem with oats is that they are a significant source of mycotoxins in the diet, which are mold based toxins that can cause an array of gut problems, hormone problems and more. Lastly, oats can also contain high levels of the toxic heavy metal Cadmium, which is linked to health problems as this toxic heavy metal accumulates in your body. 2\. Quinoa Quinoa is another food that is pitched as a health food or a "superfood". Unfortunately, this is another example of a food that has more downsides than good sides. First off, quinoa is high in compounds called saponins, that have been shown in some studies to cause gut damage and contribute to "leaky gut". Another problematic compound in quinoa are lectins, which are a type of antinutrient that can damage the cells of your intestines , and contribute to several gut disorders and immune system problems. Republicans made up ground and now have over 50% of the vote.** What does this mean? The good news is that Josh is still moving through to the general election. Peter,

Last week, Justice Democrats Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez — who has long
raised the alarm about AIPAC's threat to our democracy — joined our
movement to Reject AIPAC from the Democratic Party.

She then gave a powerful speech on the U.S. House floor calling the
situation in Gaza what it is: genocide.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240326-aoc.hOekHr&refcode=em20240326-34006&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=34006%2E1203867%2EdN7oPN ]Tweet from State of the Union: “I believe we have crossed the threshold
of intent.” On @CNNSOTU, Democratic Rep. @AOC defends her speech on the
House floor saying the humanitarian crisis in Gaza constitutes a
“genocide” for the first time.

AOC called on President Biden to halt weapons transfers to Israel and
voted against the spending bill that cut UNRWA funding (Palestinians’
largest source of humanitarian aid) through 2025 and granted $3.8 billion
to the Israeli military.

Governments, international aid organizations, and U.S. officials have made
it clear that the Israeli government is intentionally blocking aid to more
than 1 million starving people, creating a forced famine. Like AOC told
CNN’s Jake Tapper, “The actions of Hamas should not be tied to whether a
three-year-old can eat.”

What we’re witnessing is collective punishment, and AOC isn’t standing for
it.

Just like the NRA wants Congress to continue allowing the mass shootings
of children in schools and people in communities across the United States
for the sake of gun lobby profits, AIPAC wants Congress to continue
enabling the death and destruction of Palestinians all on the U.S.
taxpayer’s dime.

try and remove AOC and the rest of the Squad from Congress this year

# "LET THEM EAT BUGS"
...is neither 'unifying', nor COMMON SENSE. IT'S SICK!

Dear ,

I have to be straight with you and clear - even some "conservatives" in this race are willing to sell you out on a FAKE BURGER with a soy latte. Globalist WEF kingpin Klaus Schwab wants us to "have nothing," eat bugs and be happy. And misguided, weak "conservative Republicans are setting you up to limit our beef enjoyment. Yes, for real.

Yesterday, a primary opponent who also trashed President Trump at our debates last month before I called him out for it, wrote to supporters an e-mail - inferring his publicly "liked" support for the just-passed horrific "budget" stating the Party line saying: "Now it is our time to work together for what the vast majority of Maryland want to see."

Make no mistake - the just-passed spending bill "budget" is not common sense and if the "vast majority" of Maryland knew what was in it - especially the Sixth District where I am running to be your voice - they would not only oppose it, they would say - YOU EAT THE BUGS, Washington D.C.!
[](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=d4abb433f9&e=5bb5efcda7)
But that is what this budget proposes to include. RFID chip-tracking technology for the federal government to be able to monitor and potentially limit every single cattle farmer's herd in America - **all with CCP-Communist Chinese computer chips.** _They don't want us to have freedom to raise healthy beef for market._

That's not "working together" - _**that's working together with globalist hacks**_. And it will destroy the small rancher if the proposed mandatory tracking rule becomes permanent law.

[Send me to Congress](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=60111649e6&e=5bb5efcda7) to keep our beef and our food supply free of communist and federal control.

The time could not be more urgent for real, genuine America First conservatives who know how to defeat the "eat the bugs" nonsense attack on our farmers. I'm not only a constitutional attorney - I've raised natural, healthy beef for market for nearly all my life.

My FEC deadline is in days. Send the weak-willed and the far-Left Democrats a clear message - we want a true voice for freedom in Congress. Please help with your largest donation today. NOW IS THE TIME.

Here's to BEEF for Dinner,

[](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=7758585773&e=5bb5efcda7)
Dan Cox, Candidate for YOUR VOICE in Congress (R-MD6)

P.S. **We continue to keep those in prayer whose loved-ones were lost in today's Francis Scott Key Bridge collapse by the ship**. We need to strengthen our roads and bridges, not track and federally limit our nation's beef with Communist Chinese RFID ear tags.

name: OcasioCortez.com
subject: Honoring our alliances does not mean facilitating mass killing
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Alexandria has called for a ceasefire in Palestine since the beginning of the Israel-Hamas War, but on Friday she stood up in the House to demand action to prevent the genocide unfolding in Gaza.
Please read Alexandria’s full speech below, published in the op-ed section of _The Guardian_ yesterday.
* * *
I know a man, a decent man, who said that “preventing genocide is an achievable goal, a goal that requires a level of government organization and engagement that matches in its intensity the brutality and efficiency required to carry out mass killing. Too often, these efforts have come too late, after the best and least costly opportunities to prevent them have been missed.”
The man that said that was then Vice-President and now President Joseph Biden. And he was right.
**I rise to say that such a time is now.** As we speak, in this moment, 1.1 million innocents in Gaza are at famine’s door. A famine that is being intentionally precipitated through the blocking of food and global humanitarian assistance by leaders in the Israeli government.
This is a mass starvation of people, engineered and orchestrated following the killing of another 30,000, 70% of whom were women and children.
There is hardly a single hospital left. And this was all accomplished with US resources and weapons. **If you want to know what an unfolding genocide looks like, open your eyes.** It looks like the forced famine of 1.1 million innocents. It looks like thousands of children eating grass as their bodies consume themselves, while trucks of food are slowed and halted just miles away. It looks like good and decent people who do nothing. Or too little. Too late.
It is against United States law to provide weapons to forces who block United States humanitarian assistance. And that is exactly what is happening right now. So much so that the president himself stated, during the State of the Union, that the United States must and will be building its own port to let aid through. It will be too late.
**The time is now to force compliance with US law and the standards of humanity.** And fulfill our obligations to the American people to suspend the transfer of US weapons to the Israeli government in order to stop and prevent further atrocity.
Honoring our alliances does not mean facilitating mass killing. We cannot hide from our responsibility any longer. Blocking assistance from one’s closest allies to starve a million people is not unintentional.
We have a responsibility to prove the value of global democracy, enshrined in the upholding of civil society, rule of law, and commitment to human and civil rights.
**This is not just about Israel or Gaza. This is about us.** The world will never be the same. And we will never be the same. And we must write our story in this moment, of what it means and who we are as Americans.
And our story must be not that we were good men who did nothing. But that we were a committed democracy that did something.
And we must prove that now. With that, I yield back. Thank you.
* * *
Thank you for reading,
Team AOC
